Authors: Yiqing Yuan, Zhi Li, Jinrong Yang, Mingshan Sun, Mei Yu Zhi, Yong Zhao, Liangliang Ren, Hui Cheng

PHD-Hand: A Printable Humanoid Dexterous Hand with Linkage-Driven 3-DOA Digits Manipulation

dexterous hand linkage-driven 3D-printable flexure hinge grasping

简要说明：本文提出一种基于连杆驱动和柔性铰链的可3D打印拟人灵巧手，通过简化传动结构降低制造成本和体积，接近人手尺寸，并通过抓取和操作实验验证其性能。

TLDR: This paper presents a novel 3D-printable humanoid dexterous hand using linkage-driven digits with flexure hinges and elastic drive rods, simplifying fabrication and achieving human-like size with low cost and easy manufacturing. The design is evaluated through grasping and manipulation tests, with findings on kinematics and control.

Abstract: Currently, dexterous humanoid robot hands are widely considered the final hardware bottleneck that hampers generalist robots from physically assisting people at home and work. As conventional tendon-driven designs suffer from high cost, demanding maintenance, poor reliability, and short durability, alternative linkage-driven designs have increasingly gained attention. Despite their potential to avoid the weaknesses of tendon-driven hands, integrating multiple degrees of actuation (DOA) in a single digit with linkage drivetrains is a challenge for design and fabrication. Only a few studies have managed to present functional humanoid hands that are completely linkage-driven and have at least three DOAs per digit without compromising actuator placement and other design preferences. Our work introduces a new linkage-driven hand featuring a unique flexure hinge. Together with elastic drive rods made of spring steel, the linkage drivetrains are significantly simplified. Unlike other linkage-driven designs of similar dexterity, our design does not require many miniature moving parts. As a result, the hand can be fabricated easily with a budget 3D printer. This not only significantly lowers the barrier to entry for using and developing dexterous humanoid robot hand functions, but also allows the hands to be sized much closer to regular human hands. The design offers desirable kinematic advantages as well. A prototype is evaluated for grasping and object manipulation. In addition, this paper presents our latest findings on kinematics and control of the hand.

摘要（中文）：目前，灵巧的人形机器人手被广泛认为是阻碍通用机器人在家庭和工作场所为人类提供物理协助的最终硬件瓶颈。由于传统的腱驱动设计存在成本高、维护要求高、可靠性差和耐久性短等问题，基于连杆驱动的替代设计日益受到关注。尽管连杆驱动设计有潜力规避腱驱动手的弱点，但在单个手指中集成多个驱动自由度（DOA）并采用连杆传动系统，在设计和制造上仍是一项挑战。目前仅有少数研究成功展示了完全由连杆驱动且每个手指至少具备三个驱动自由度的人形手，同时兼顾了执行器布局和其他设计偏好。本研究提出了一种新型连杆驱动手，其特点是采用独特的柔性铰链。结合由弹簧钢制成的弹性驱动杆，连杆传动系统得以显著简化。与同类灵巧度的其他连杆驱动设计不同，本设计无需大量微型运动部件，因此可使用经济型3D打印机轻松制造。这不仅大大降低了使用和开发灵巧人形机器人手功能的门槛，还使得手的尺寸能够更接近普通人类手的比例。该设计还具备良好的运动学优势。我们制作了一款原型机，并对其抓取和物体操作能力进行了评估。此外，本文还介绍了在手部运动学和控制方面的最新研究成果。

Authors: Neel Adwani, Muhaiminul Islam Akash, Saffia Ouali, Ethan Liu, Cong Wang

HyperDrone: Simulation-to-Reality Transfer at Millions of Frames per Second RLRobot

batch simulator ray tracing sim-to-real quadrotor vision-based control

简要说明：HyperDrone 是一个超高速批处理四旋翼模拟器，利用自定义光线追踪引擎，以每秒数百万帧的速度渲染逼真观测。它展示了将基于视觉的偏航控制策略从仿真转移到真实 Crazyflie 四旋翼的能力。

TLDR: HyperDrone is an ultra-fast batch quadrotor simulator using a custom ray-tracing engine, achieving millions of FPS for rendering photorealistic observations. It demonstrates sim-to-real transfer of a vision-based yaw control policy to a real Crazyflie quadrotor.

Abstract: We present HyperDrone, an extremely fast quadrotor simulator focused on high-performance batch rendering that is more than 20x faster than existing state-of-the-art batch quadrotor simulators. HyperDrone combines highly optimized multirotor dynamics with HyperLux, a new ray-tracing engine that supports Nvidia OptiX, Vulkan, Apple Metal and WebGPU backends that takes full advantage of modern ray-tracing hardware, capable of running both components entirely on the GPU. HyperLux renders RGB, depth, semantic/instance segmentation, surface normals and optical flow observations at configurable levels of fidelity, including reflections, realistic lighting, motion blur, anti-aliasing, and Physically Based Rendering (PBR). Even in the highest-fidelity settings, HyperLux achieves millions of Frames Per Second (FPS) on consumer-grade GPUs while rendering realistic 3D scenes. We demonstrate the merits of HyperDrone by training a vision-based yaw-control policy purely in simulation and transferring it to a real small-scale quadrotor (Crazyflie) with a camera, running completely onboard.

摘要（中文）：我们介绍了HyperDrone，一款专注于高性能批量渲染的超高速四旋翼模拟器，其渲染速度比现有最先进的批量四旋翼模拟器快20倍以上。HyperDrone将高度优化的多旋翼动力学与HyperLux相结合，后者是一种全新的光线追踪引擎，支持Nvidia OptiX、Vulkan、Apple Metal和WebGPU后端，充分利用现代光线追踪硬件，能够完全在GPU上运行这两个组件。HyperLux可渲染RGB图像、深度、语义/实例分割、表面法线和光流观测，并提供可配置的保真度选项，包括反射、真实光照、运动模糊、抗锯齿和基于物理的渲染（PBR）。即使在最高保真度设置下，HyperLux在消费级GPU上也能实现每秒数百万帧（FPS）的渲染速度，同时渲染逼真的3D场景。我们通过纯仿真训练基于视觉的偏航控制策略，并将其成功迁移到搭载摄像头、完全机载运行的真实小型四旋翼（Crazyflie）上，以此验证了HyperDrone的优越性。

Authors: Jonas Eschmann, Giuseppe Loianno

COWBOY: A Scalable Sim-to-Real Framework for Learning Contextual Whole-Body Manipulation Manipulation

sim-to-real whole-body manipulation mobile manipulator vision policy dexterous grasping

简要说明：COWBOY 提出了一种可扩展的仿真到现实框架，用于学习移动操作器的情境化全身操作，通过组合 WBC-RL 教师策略蒸馏出一个基于点云的单视觉策略，实现零样本迁移至多样化的真实场景。

TLDR: COWBOY is a scalable sim-to-real framework for learning contextual whole-body manipulation on mobile manipulators, using a composed WBC-RL teacher to distill a single vision policy that controls base, arm, hand, and camera from point clouds and transfers zero-shot to diverse real-world scenes.

Abstract: Mobile manipulators must adapt not only to objects, but also to the spatial context in which they appear: where to position the base, how to manipulate, and where to look while navigating surrounding scene geometry. To address this, we present COWBOY, a scalable sim-to-real framework for learning such contextual whole-body manipulation. On whole-body dexterous grasping, COWBOY transfers zero-shot to hundreds of objects and diverse in-the-wild scenes, spanning cluttered tabletops, shelves, drawers, and other unstructured settings. Rather than learning scene adaptation directly with RL in simulation, a vectorized environment-aware whole-body controller (WBC) handles reaching in thousands of scenes by coordinating base-arm motion, collision avoidance, and active vision. Then, local RL experts are trained in local scenes for object interaction and can be reused across thousands of full-scene layouts. We distill these composed WBC-RL teachers into a single vision policy that controls the mobile base, arm, dexterous hand, and actuated camera from point-cloud observations. The resulting policy exhibits contextual whole-body behavior, automatically adapting base placement, camera viewpoint, arm trajectory, and grasp strategy to observed scene and object geometry. Videos are available at https://cowboy-manip.com

摘要（中文）：移动操作机器人不仅需要适应物体本身，还必须适应物体所处的空间情境：基底应放置在哪里，如何进行操作，以及在导航周围场景几何结构时视线应投向何处。为此，我们提出了COWBOY——一个可扩展的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）学习框架，用于学习此类情境感知的全身操作。在全身灵巧抓取任务中，COWBOY能够零样本迁移至数百个物体及多样化的真实场景，涵盖杂乱的桌面、货架、抽屉及其他非结构化环境。我们没有直接在仿真中通过强化学习（RL）学习场景适应，而是采用一种向量化的环境感知全身控制器（WBC），通过协调基底-手臂运动、碰撞避免和主动视觉，在数千个场景中完成到达操作。随后，在局部场景中训练局部RL专家模型以处理物体交互，并可跨数千种全场景布局复用。我们将这些由WBC-RL组合而成的教师模型蒸馏为一个统一的视觉策略，该策略基于点云观测控制移动基底、手臂、灵巧手及主动相机。最终得到的策略展现出情境感知的全身行为，能够根据观测到的场景和物体几何结构，自动调整基底位置、相机视角、手臂轨迹及抓取策略。视频见 https://cowboy-manip.com

Authors: Jiahui Yang, Jason Jingzhou Liu, Ray Muxin Liu, Andrew E. Wang, Kenneth Shaw, Deepak Pathak, Ruslan Salakhutdinov

Navigation Explainability for Object Avoidance with LLMs for Assistive Robots Locomotion

navigation explanation obstacle avoidance large language model assistive robot user trust

简要说明：本文提出了一种上下文感知的导航解释框架，利用大语言模型为辅助机器人生成关于避障和导航动作的自然语言解释，并在Unitree Go2平台上验证，结果表明结合障碍物信息和未来轨迹能提高用户信任和满意度。

TLDR: This paper introduces a Context-Aware Navigation Explanation framework that uses LLMs to generate natural-language explanations of guide dog movements for obstacle avoidance in assistive robots, tested on a Unitree Go2 platform, showing that combining obstacle information with future trajectories improves user trust and satisfaction.

Abstract: Blind and visually impaired individuals face uncertainty when navigating unfamiliar areas. Whether a cane or a guide dog is used for navigation, this may prove to be challenging. To mitigate this challenge, we present the Context-Aware Navigation Explanation framework that explains guide dog movements for obstacle avoidance and navigation using a large language model. This system integrates perceptual context with planned future trajectories to generate natural-language explanations of robot movement. We deploy the system on a Unitree Go2 platform in indoor navigation scenarios and evaluate how different explanation context configurations affect user trust and explanation satisfaction. Results show a strong positive relationship between explanation satisfaction and trust, and suggest that combining obstacle information with future trajectory leads to the most effective explanations. These findings highlight the potential of context-aware language explanations to improve transparency and trust in assistive robot navigation.

摘要（中文）：盲人与视障人士在陌生环境中导航时面临不确定性。无论是使用手杖还是导盲犬进行导航，这一过程都颇具挑战。为缓解这一难题，我们提出了情境感知导航解释框架，该框架利用大型语言模型解释导盲犬在避障与导航中的动作。该系统将感知情境与规划的未来轨迹相结合，生成关于机器人运动的自然语言解释。我们在室内导航场景中将该系统部署于宇树Go2平台，并评估了不同解释情境配置对用户信任度与解释满意度的影响。结果表明，解释满意度与信任度之间存在显著正相关关系，且将障碍物信息与未来轨迹相结合能够产生最有效的解释。这些发现凸显了情境感知语言解释在提升辅助机器人导航透明度和信任度方面的潜力。

Authors: Courtney Young, Yi Lian, Taery Kim, Sehoon Ha

inr2action: Encoding Robot Episodes as Neural Implicit Representations for Recall and Action VLA

neural implicit representation parameter-space memory meta-learned initialization weight delta robot episodes

简要说明：该论文提出了一种用于机器人 episode 的参数空间记忆框架，通过元学习的初始化将每个 episode 编码为神经隐式表示的权重增量，该增量大小固定，支持基于语言的问题回答和关节命令回归，无需检索帧，从而将记忆成本与时间跨度解耦。

TLDR: The paper introduces a parameter-space memory framework for robotic episodes, encoding each episode as a fixed-size weight delta from a meta-learned initialization of a neural implicit representation. This memory supports language-based question answering and joint command regression without frame retrieval, enabling constant memory cost regardless of episode length.

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic operation requires memory that scales with essential information rather than execution time. We present a parameter-space memory framework where each episode is stored as a separable object. A neural implicit representation is fitted to episode video from a shared, meta-learned initialization; the resulting weight delta constitutes the memory. Crucially, this delta remains a fixed size regardless of whether the episode spans a hundred or a hundred thousand frames. A learned projector maps the weight delta into token embeddings, conditioning a language model for question answering and a decoder for joint command regression, without frame retrieval at query time. On RoboMME, the language model exceeds chance across all question types, and the decoder achieves a mean $R^2$ of 0.51. Replacing the delta with matched noise drops performance by 11.4 points, while random-origin weights are non-decodable, proving the meta-learned initialization is essential for embedding episode content. By representing individual experiences as fixed-size weight deltas in a common parameter space, this approach decouples memory cost from time horizon and provides a basis for scalable streaming memory.

摘要（中文）：长期机器人操作需要一种记忆机制，其规模应与关键信息量成正比，而非执行时间。我们提出了一种参数空间记忆框架，其中每个片段被存储为一个可分离的对象。通过共享的元学习初始化，神经隐式表示被拟合到片段视频上，得到的权重增量即构成记忆。关键在于，无论片段包含一百帧还是十万帧，该增量的尺寸始终保持固定。一个学习得到的投影器将权重增量映射为令牌嵌入，从而为语言模型的问答任务和关节命令回归的解码器提供条件，而查询时无需进行帧检索。在RoboMME上，该语言模型在所有问题类型上的表现均优于随机水平，解码器的平均$R^2$达到0.51。将增量替换为匹配噪声会使性能下降11.4个百分点，而随机初始化的权重则完全无法解码，这证明了元学习初始化对于嵌入片段内容至关重要。通过将单个经验表示为公共参数空间中的固定大小权重增量，该方法使记忆成本与时间跨度解耦，并为可扩展的流式记忆奠定了基础。

Authors: Leann Alhashishi, Christos Margadji, Sebastian William Pattinson

T-WLA: Bridging Slow Vision and Fast Touch Manipulation

Vision-Language-Action Tactile correction Visual memory Dexterous manipulation World model

简要说明：T-WLA 提出了一种世界-语言-动作架构，通过共享视觉记忆同时指导动作生成和轻量级触觉修正，在真实灵巧操作任务上将手指关节 MPJPE 降低 30%，平均成功率约为 50%。

TLDR: T-WLA introduces a world-language-action architecture that uses a shared visual memory to condition both action generation and lightweight tactile corrections, reducing finger-joint MPJPE by 30% and achieving about 50% success on real-world dexterous manipulation tasks.

Abstract: In contact-rich manipulation, contact conditions can change before a visual policy updates its action plan. Recomputing the plan through the visual policy adds latency, while tactile feedback alone does not specify how the ongoing motion should be revised for the task. We introduce T-WLA, a world-language-action architecture that uses shared visual memory to guide both action generation and tactile correction. At each visual update, the visual branch integrates the current image, task instruction, and retrieved history into a visual memory that conditions base-action generation. The same memory is cached for a lightweight tactile editor, which combines it with the active action chunk and incoming touch to predict residual corrections to unexecuted actions without rerunning the visual branch. Future-image and future-pressure prediction provide training-only supervision, encouraging the visual memory and tactile features to capture interaction dynamics relevant to action generation and correction. We evaluate T-WLA on tactile-conditioned hand-motion prediction using EgoTouch and Tachin, and on four real-world dexterous manipulation tasks. T-WLA reduces finger-joint MPJPE by 30% relative to the strongest reported baseline and achieves an average success rate of approximately 50.0% across real-robot manipulation tasks. Videos and code are available at https://anonymous-submission-20.github.io/T-WLA.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：在接触密集的操作中，接触条件可能在视觉策略更新其行动计划之前发生变化。通过视觉策略重新计算计划会增加延迟，而仅依靠触觉反馈无法明确如何针对任务修正当前进行中的动作。我们提出了T-WLA，一种世界-语言-动作架构，利用共享的视觉记忆来引导动作生成和触觉修正。在每次视觉更新中，视觉分支将当前图像、任务指令和检索到的历史信息整合为视觉记忆，用于条件化基础动作生成。相同的记忆被缓存给轻量级的触觉编辑器，该编辑器将记忆与当前动作片段及传入的触觉信息结合，预测对未执行动作的残差修正，而无需重新运行视觉分支。未来图像和未来压力的预测提供仅用于训练的监督信号，促使视觉记忆和触觉特征捕捉与动作生成和修正相关的交互动态。我们在使用EgoTouch和Tachin进行的触觉条件手部动作预测任务，以及四个真实世界的灵巧操作任务上评估了T-WLA。与最强的已有基线相比，T-WLA将手指关节的MPJPE降低了30%，并在真实机器人操作任务中达到约50.0%的平均成功率。视频和代码可在 https://anonymous-submission-20.github.io/T-WLA.github.io/ 获取。

Authors: Kaichen Zhou, Yuzhen Chen, Hannah Yao, Chonghe Jiang, Rao Fu, Xihang Yu, Wei Dai, Bashar Kabbarah, Haoyu Chen, Ishita Goluguri, Zhiyang Dou, Haonan Chen, Fangneng Zhan, Mengyu Wang, Wojciech Matusik, Antonio Torralba, Paul Pu Liang

Rethinking Video Autoencoders for Interactive World Models WorldModel

video world models latent compression diffusion autoencoder causal representation manipulation and navigation

简要说明：本文提出了 CADRE，一系列具有不同时空压缩的因果扩散表示自编码器，以研究用于机器人交互式世界模型的视频自编码器应如何压缩，发现操作和导航需要相反的压缩策略，并且扩散解码器在高压缩下能保持清晰度。

TLDR: The paper introduces CADRE, a family of causal diffusion representation autoencoders with varying spatio-temporal compressions, to study how video autoencoders should compress for interactive world models used in robotics, finding that manipulation and navigation benefit from opposite compressions and that diffusion decoders keep sharpness at high compression.

Abstract: Video world models predict future frames from past frames and actions. They serve as simulators in which agents train, plan or are evaluated, and that humans can control interactively. They generate in the latent space of a video autoencoder, whose compression sets their cost per frame and how long each action waits to take effect. Yet world models often reuse the autoencoders of text-to-video generators, built for offline generation with no agent waiting and, without their training data and code, not retrainable at another compression. We therefore ask how, where and how much a world model should compress. We build CADRE, an open family of causal diffusion representation autoencoders spanning multiple spatio-temporal compressions. Its members differ only in a small bottleneck on frozen features and share a diffusion decoder self-distilled to one or a few steps. We train the same world model on each autoencoder in two domains, manipulation and navigation, with two environments each. CADRE forms most of the latency-quality frontier, especially with a moving camera. Our study also leads to four findings. At strong compression, a diffusion decoder is sharper than perceptual regression. In robot manipulation, temporal compression is more effective in the autoencoder than in the world model. Manipulation and navigation call for opposite compressions: temporal compression costs little when the camera is still, and spatial compression when it moves. Surprisingly, with a still camera, coarser spatial tokens hurt motion far more than image quality. Code, models and a live demo are at https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型根据过去的帧和动作来预测未来的帧。它们充当智能体进行训练、规划或评估的模拟器，人类也可以对其交互式控制。此类模型在视频自编码器的潜空间中生成内容，而自编码器的压缩决定了每帧的计算成本以及每个动作生效所需的等待时间。然而，世界模型常常复用文生视频生成器中的自编码器，这类自编码器是为离线生成而构建的，无需智能体等待，且由于缺乏训练数据和代码，无法在另一种压缩条件下重新训练。因此，我们探讨世界模型应当如何压缩、在何处压缩以及压缩到何种程度。我们构建了CADRE，一个开放式的因果扩散表示自编码器家族，涵盖多种时空压缩配置。其各成员仅在冻结特征上的小型瓶颈处有所不同，并共享一个通过自蒸馏实现单步或少数几步推理的扩散解码器。我们在两个领域——操作和导航，每个领域各含两个环境——中使用相同的世界模型对每个自编码器进行训练。CADRE在很大程度上构成了延迟-质量前沿，尤其是在移动摄像头的场景下。我们的研究还带来了四项发现。在强压缩条件下，扩散解码器比感知回归更为清晰。在机器人操作中，时间压缩在自编码器中的效果优于在世界模型中的效果。操作和导航任务对压缩的需求恰好相反：当摄像头静止时，时间压缩代价很小；而当摄像头移动时，空间压缩代价较小。令人意外的是，在摄像头静止的情况下，更粗糙的空间令牌对运动的影响远大于对图像质量的影响。代码、模型和在线演示见 https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre

Authors: Adrien Ramanana Rahary, Yutong Bai, Nicolas Dufour, Patrick Pérez, David Picard

ALPS: Visual State Encoders for World Models WorldModel

visual state encoder world model language alignment pixel reconstruction robot policy

简要说明：本文提出ALPS，一种预训练的视觉状态编码器，将物理状态信息、语言对齐和像素重建设一于世界模型的统一表示中。ALPS在状态探测基准、下游机器人策略学习和世界模型规划中表现优异，并支持将预测的未来token直接解码为像素用于可视化检查。

TLDR: This paper introduces ALPS, a pretrained visual state encoder that unifies physical-state information, language alignment, and pixel reconstruction into a single set of patch tokens for world models. ALPS demonstrates superior performance on state-probe benchmarks, downstream robot policy learning, and world-model planning, while enabling future token decoding into pixels for visual inspection.

Abstract: World models turn visual representations into predictions and actions. We argue that their visual foundation should combine physical-state information, native language alignment, and pixel reconstruction, so that a single representation can support prediction, instruction, and inspection. However, existing encoders typically specialize in only one or two of these capabilities; we therefore introduce ALPS, a pretrained visual state encoder that unifies all three in a single set of patch tokens. Using only still images and text, we pretrain a ViT-B/16 from scratch with language, reconstruction, and spatial correspondence objectives, and then refine it via cross-view self-distillation. In a unified evaluation across fifteen public encoders, ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate LIBERO state-probe error among ViT-B models (matching the 3.5x larger V-JEPA 2-L) while maintaining strong language alignment and accurate pixel reconstruction. Downstream, frozen ALPS tokens reach the highest mean policy success on LIBERO (85.5%) when paired with our native text tower, match or exceed leading encoders on world-model planning across PushT, Wall, and Granular, and allow predicted future tokens to be decoded directly into pixels for visual inspection. We hope this work helps establish visual pretraining as a shared foundation for understanding, prediction, and action in world models.

摘要（中文）：世界模型将视觉表征转化为预测与行动。我们认为，其视觉基础应融合物理状态信息、原生语言对齐以及像素重建，从而使单一表征能够同时支撑预测、指令理解与视觉检查。然而，现有编码器通常仅专注于以上能力中的一种或两种；为此，我们提出了ALPS——一种预训练的视觉状态编码器，在统一的patch token集合中整合了全部三项能力。仅利用静态图像和文本，我们从零开始以语言、重建及空间对应目标训练了一个ViT-B/16模型，并通过跨视角自蒸馏进一步精炼。在涵盖十五个公开编码器的统一评估中，ALPS在ViT-B模型中取得了最低的LIBERO状态探测聚合误差（与体积大3.5倍的V-JEPA 2-L相当），同时保持了强大的语言对齐能力与准确的像素重建性能。在下游任务中，冻结的ALPS token在与我们的原生文本塔配合时，在LIBERO上取得了最高的平均策略成功率（85.5%），在PushT、Wall和Granular的世界模型规划任务中达到或超越了领先编码器的表现，并且能够将预测的未来token直接解码为像素，以支持视觉检查。我们希望这项工作能够推动视觉预训练成为世界模型中理解、预测与行动的共享基础。

Authors: Yanqing Liu, Letian Zhang, Chengzhi Liu, Zijun Wang, Jieru Mei, Hongliang Fei, Yuyin Zhou, Cihang Xie

NeuralSRender: G-Buffer Guided Video Diffusion for Sim-to-Real Rendering AutonomousDriving

sim-to-real video diffusion G-buffer autonomous driving perception

简要说明：NeuralSRender通过将G-buffer几何和材质先验注入预训练的视频扩散Transformer并结合LoRA，增强合成驾驶视频的逼真度以用于sim-to-real迁移，从而提升下游感知性能。

TLDR: NeuralSRender enhances the photorealism of synthetic driving videos for sim-to-real transfer by injecting G-buffer geometric and material priors into a pretrained video diffusion transformer with LoRA, improving downstream perception performance.

Abstract: The scarcity of high-quality annotated visual data remains a critical bottleneck for autonomous-driving perception. Simulators provide training data at scale, but the limited realism of synthetic videos compromises perception performance in real-world applications. To address this limitation, we propose NeuralSRender, a sim-to-real video translation framework that enhances the photorealism of synthetic videos while maintaining geometric consistency with the source scenes. Built on a pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT), NeuralSRender uses a lightweight projector to inject geometric and material priors from G-buffers, and LoRA enables parameter-efficient adaptation. The model is trained in two stages: it first learns G-buffer conditioning from synthetic videos with accurate G-buffers, then adapts to real-world appearance using real videos with estimated G-buffers. During the second stage, an additional LoRA module is trained while the projector and first-stage LoRA remain frozen to reduce interference from estimation noise. NeuralSRender introduces only 1.45\% parameter overhead and can be trained on consumer-grade GPUs with 24 GB of memory. To support training and evaluation, we introduce GenReal, a large-scale driving video dataset comprising synthetic and real-world videos with corresponding G-buffers. Experiments demonstrate improved photorealism with competitive geometric consistency. Training perception models on our translated videos instead of raw simulator renders improves detection $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$ on nuImages from 35.1 to 40.6 and segmentation mIoU on Cityscapes from 32.4 to 40.8. Our code, data, and model weights are available at: https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/NeuralSRender.

摘要（中文）：高质量标注视觉数据的稀缺性仍然是自动驾驶感知领域的关键瓶颈。仿真器可提供大规模训练数据，但合成视频的逼真度有限，导致模型在真实应用中的感知性能受损。为解决这一问题，我们提出了NeuralSRender，一种仿真到现实的视频转换框架，能够在保持与源场景几何一致性的同时，提升合成视频的逼真度。该框架基于预训练的视频扩散变换器（DiT），通过轻量级投影器注入来自G-buffer的几何与材质先验，并采用LoRA实现参数高效适配。模型采用两阶段训练方式：第一阶段利用具有精确G-buffer的合成视频学习G-buffer条件控制；第二阶段使用带有估计G-buffer的真实视频适配真实外观。在第二阶段中，额外训练一个LoRA模块，同时保持投影器和第一阶段LoRA冻结不变，以减少估计噪声的干扰。NeuralSRender仅引入1.45%的参数开销，可在24 GB显存的消费级GPU上完成训练。为支持训练与评估，我们构建了GenReal，一个包含合成视频和真实视频及其对应G-buffer的大规模驾驶数据集。实验结果表明，该方法在提升逼真度的同时保持了有竞争力的几何一致性。将感知模型在我们的转换视频而非原始仿真渲染结果上进行训练，在nuImages上的检测AP50从35.1提升至40.6，在Cityscapes上的分割mIoU从32.4提升至40.8。我们的代码、数据和模型权重可在 https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/NeuralSRender 获取。

Authors: Yipeng Lu, Youqi Liao, Zhenyu Wang, Yuning Peng, Zhen Dong

HorizonComposer: Spatiotemporally Consistent Driving Video Editing with Enriched Traffic Semantics AutonomousDriving

driving video editing traffic semantics spatiotemporal consistency offline reinforcement learning thinking frames

简要说明：HorizonComposer 通过混合数据、类似强化学习的密集奖励和思考帧机制，在指令引导的驾驶视频编辑中保持交通语义，提升了时空一致性和下游感知性能。

TLDR: HorizonComposer improves instruction-guided driving video editing by preserving traffic semantics via hybrid data, reinforcement-learning-like dense rewards, and thinking frames, leading to better spatiotemporal consistency and downstream perception gains.

Abstract: Instruction-guided video generative models offer a scalable solution for stress-testing autonomous driving systems by simulating diverse environmental conditions. However, driving scenes operate within a dense Operational Design Domain (ODD) governed by strict traffic semantics. When applied to global driving-condition edits, general-purpose instruction-guided video editors frequently corrupt these semantics, leading to structural hallucinations and ``temporal shock.'' This work distills and protects traffic semantics during video editing at three levels. First, we construct a hybrid dataset by combining temporally aligned real-world videos with synthetic edits, balancing foundational scene structure with unambiguous appearance signals. Second, during training, we adapt advantage conditioning from offline reinforcement learning to align the model using dense rewards. We extract dense, pixel-level rewards from the hybrid data to serve as a localized signal and actively steer generation toward structurally reliable pixels. Finally, our model mitigates temporal shock by introducing thinking frames, a transition mechanism that seamlessly reconciles static image conditioning with dynamic video context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method prevents the corruption of multi-actor dynamics, establishing state-of-the-art spatiotemporal consistency, yielding consistent user preference (39% relative improvement in content preservation and 12% in temporal consistency), and achieving a significant 5% gain in downstream road line segmentation and 7% gain in downstream multi-object detection.

摘要（中文）：指令引导的视频生成模型通过模拟多样化的环境条件，为自动驾驶系统的压力测试提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。然而，驾驶场景运行在一个受严格交通语义约束的密集运行设计域（ODD）中。当应用于全局驾驶条件编辑时，通用型指令引导视频编辑器 frequently 会破坏这些语义，导致结构幻觉和“时间冲击”。本工作从三个层面在视频编辑过程中提炼并保护交通语义。首先，我们通过将时间对齐的真实世界视频与合成编辑相结合，构建了一个混合数据集，在基础场景结构与清晰的外观信号之间取得平衡。其次，在训练过程中，我们借鉴离线强化学习中的优势条件化方法，利用密集奖励对模型进行对齐。我们从混合数据中提取密集的像素级奖励，作为局部信号，主动引导生成过程朝向结构可靠的像素。最后，我们的模型通过引入思考帧来缓解时间冲击，这是一种过渡机制，能够无缝调和静态图像条件与动态视频上下文之间的关系。大量实验表明，我们的方法能够防止多智能体动态的破坏，建立了最先进的时空一致性，带来一致的用户偏好（内容保留相对提升39%，时间一致性提升12%），并在下游车道线分割中取得5%的显著提升，在下游多目标检测中取得7%的提升。

Authors: Mauricio Soroco, Yuqiu Liu, Zaid Tasneem, Francesco Pittaluga, Abhishek Aich, Wuyang Chen, Manmohan Chandraker, Ziyu Jiang

PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models WorldModel

world models in-context learning physics calibration action-conditioned prediction descriptor token

简要说明：PhysiCalWorld 通过上下文提示，将探索性交互片段编码为紧凑描述符令牌，校准动作条件世界模型以匹配实例特定物理特性，无需微调或物理标签，提升多样物理环境下的预测和规划性能。

TLDR: PhysiCalWorld calibrates action-conditioned world models to instance-specific physics via in-context prompting, using an exploratory interaction clip encoded into a compact descriptor token, improving prediction and planning across diverse physics without fine-tuning or physics labels.

Abstract: Existing world models typically perceive a scene through current visual frame or a narrow history window. However, these observations may not reveal the physics properties that determine transition dynamics, such as an object's mass distribution, joint damping, or surface friction. Without calibrating these physics factors for world models, predictions tend to regress toward an empirical prior and induce severe drift in novel test scenes. To this end, we propose PhysiCalWorld, which calibrates action-conditioned world models to the instance-specific dynamics via in-context prompting, without fine-tuning or analytical physics modeling. Our method encodes an exploratory interaction clip collected within the test scene into a compact physics descriptor token, which grounds subsequent predictions in the scene's actual physical behavior. PhysiCalWorld is trained end-to-end with the latent prediction loss alone, without physics labels. At inference time, the descriptor token is extracted once and can be reused across rollouts with negligible compute overhead. We evaluate PhysiCalWorld across four environments covering diverse physics variations and show that it substantially improves rollout prediction accuracy and visual planning success rate. The learned descriptors also form a physically structured latent space and generalize beyond the physics ranges seen during training.

摘要（中文）：现有世界模型通常通过当前视觉帧或有限的历史窗口来感知场景。然而，这些观测可能无法揭示决定转移动力学的物理属性，例如物体的质量分布、关节阻尼或表面摩擦。如果不对世界模型进行这些物理因素的校准，预测往往会回归到经验先验，并在新的测试场景中引发严重漂移。为此，我们提出了PhysiCalWorld，该方法通过上下文提示将对动作条件世界模型校准到实例特定的动力学，而无需微调或解析物理建模。我们的方法将测试场景中收集的一段探索性交互片段编码为紧凑的物理描述符令牌，使后续预测基于该场景的实际物理行为。PhysiCalWorld仅使用潜在预测损失进行端到端训练，无需物理标签。在推理时，描述符令牌仅提取一次，可在多次展开中复用，计算开销可忽略不计。我们在涵盖多种物理变化的四个环境中评估了PhysiCalWorld，结果表明其显著提高了展开预测准确性和视觉规划成功率。学习到的描述符还形成了具有物理结构的潜在空间，并能泛化到训练中未见过的物理范围之外。

Authors: Yunhao Luo, Wentao He, Yinpei Dai, Hyelin Nam, Hongze Fu, Joyce Chai, Nima Fazeli, Jeong Joon Park

Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use Other

multimodal embodied agents capability-centric framework computer-use robot-use physical constraints

简要说明：本文提出了PAPAV，一个以能力为中心的框架（感知、预期、规划、行动、验证），用于统一和比较计算机使用与机器人使用场景中的多模态具身智能体，并分析了物理约束与基准测试缺口。

TLDR: This paper proposes PAPAV, a capability-centric framework (Perceive, Anticipate, Plan, Act, Verify) to unify and compare multimodal embodied agents across computer-use and robot-use settings, analyzing physical constraints and benchmark gaps.

Abstract: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

摘要（中文）：多模态智能体（MMAs）通过推理、记忆、工具和反馈维持交互，最典型地体现为计算机使用智能体，而机器人系统（RSs）则将感知与驱动耦合于物理动力学之中。我们将多模态具身智能体（MMEAs）定义为目标导向的系统，其将多模态任务推理与物理动作相结合，并根据由此产生的反馈修正决策。这引出一个核心问题：当多模态智能体从计算机使用转向机器人使用时，会带来哪些变化？我们提出PAPAV框架，这是一个以能力为中心的统—框架，包含五个反复出现的功能：感知当前状态（Perceive）、预测动作效果（Anticipate）、规划可行方案（Plan）、通过接口或身体执行（Act）以及验证结果（Verify）。这五种能力按功能而非架构来定义，使PAPAV能够识别三者共同之处，进而对MMEAs与MMAs及RSs进行比较。从部分可观测性到不可验证的结果，五个物理约束条件使得预先确定的选项更少，纠错回旋余地也更小。在64个基准测试中，明确评估的重点集中在执行（Act）环节；仅有5个基准评估了预测（Anticipate），3个评估了验证（Verify），导致这两项能力大多隐藏在任务成功率背后。这些约束条件也构成了我们所识别的开放性挑战。因此，PAPAV为设计可靠的物理智能体以及衡量全部五种能力的进展（而非仅凭任务成功率）提供了共同基础。

Authors: Yanzhe Chen, Ziyi Yang, Jifeng Zhu, Qiming Huang, Ruihe An, Peiyao Xu, Hesen Yang, Runda Liu, Chang Gong, Zhijun Cao, Zechen Bai, Wenzheng Zeng, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou

From Reasoning to Action: Benchmarking Frontier AI Models on LIBERO-10 Robot Manipulation Tasks Manipulation

robot manipulation frontier AI models LIBERO benchmark closed-loop control end-effector pose

简要说明：本文提出了一个闭环框架，在LIBERO-10机器人操作任务上评估了六种前沿AI模型，发现GPT-6 Astra成功率最高（44%），增加推理时间通常能提升性能，但收益因模型而异且伴随额外推理开销。

TLDR: The paper presents a closed-loop framework to evaluate six frontier AI models on LIBERO-10 robot manipulation tasks, finding GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate (44%) and that increased reasoning effort generally improves performance but with varying benefits and costs.

Abstract: Recent advances in frontier AI models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, planning, and tool use, raising the possibility of using general-purpose AI models for robot manipulation without task-specific training. However, their manipulation capabilities have not been systematically evaluated on standardized robotics benchmarks. In this report, we present a unified closed-loop manipulation framework for evaluating frontier AI models on the LIBERO-10 benchmark. Our framework enables models to control a robot directly through visual observations, robot proprioception, and structured tool calls, primarily by specifying target end-effector poses and gripper commands, without task-specific fine-tuning or pretrained manipulation skills. We evaluate six frontier AI models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5, and Gemini-4 Argon, across three reasoning effort levels, resulting in 18 configurations and 1,800 evaluation episodes. Our results show that GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate of 44%, followed by Gemini-4 Argon at 43%. Increasing reasoning effort generally improves manipulation performance, but the benefits vary across models and come at additional inference cost. We also observe substantial differences across tasks, with models performing relatively well on object placement tasks but struggling with precise spatial arrangements and complex multi-step interactions. These findings demonstrate both the potential and limitations of frontier AI models for robot manipulation, highlighting the challenges of translating reasoning capabilities into reliable physical actions. We release our evaluation framework and experimental results to support reproducible benchmarking and future research on reasoning-based robot manipulation.

摘要（中文）：近期前沿AI模型的进展已在视觉理解、推理、规划及工具使用方面展现出卓越能力，这引发了利用通用AI模型进行机器人操作而无需任务特定训练的可能性。然而，这些模型的操作能力尚未在标准化机器人基准上进行系统评估。本报告中，我们提出了一种统一的闭环操作框架，用于在LIBERO-10基准上评估前沿AI模型。该框架使模型能够通过视觉观测、机器人本体感觉及结构化工具调用直接控制机器人，主要通过指定末端执行器目标位姿和夹爪指令实现，而无需任务特定的微调或预训练操作技能。我们评估了六种前沿AI模型，包括GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Luna、Claude Opus 5、Claude Opus 5.5及Gemini-4 Argon，涵盖三种推理努力水平，共构成18种配置和1,800个评估片段。结果表明，GPT-6 Astra取得了44%的最高成功率，紧随其后的是Gemini-4 Argon，成功率为43%。增加推理努力通常能提升操作性能，但收益因模型而异，且伴随额外的推理成本。我们还观察到不同任务间存在显著差异，模型在物体放置任务上表现相对较好，但在精确空间排列和复杂多步交互上则面临挑战。这些发现既展示了前沿AI模型在机器人操作方面的潜力，也揭示了其局限性，凸显了将推理能力转化为可靠物理行动的挑战。我们发布了评估框架和实验结果，以支持可复现的基准测试及未来基于推理的机器人操作研究。

Authors: May Espinola, Qifan Zhang, Yu Xiang

TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments HumanoidEmbodied

embodied agent multimodal LLM long-horizon physical simulation human-robot interaction

简要说明：TARSphere是一个面向长时程具身智能体的全栈框架与基准，在物理和社会模拟环境中，通过冻结多模态大模型与分层技能驱动智能体，并在360个包含动态变化条件的场景中评估其表现。

TLDR: TARSphere is a full-stack framework and benchmark for evaluating long-horizon embodied agents in simulated physical and social environments, using a frozen MLLM brain with hierarchical skills and event-driven task state updates, tested across 360 episodes reflecting evolving conditions.

Abstract: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. An event-driven finite-state machine (FSM) uses completed actions and delivered information to update task states and evaluate outcomes. TARSphere-Harness, its embodied brain harness, lets a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM) act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise its decisions. On this foundation, agent-in-the-loop curation aligns task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry to construct TARSphere-Bench: 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes. Five paired conditions assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding for navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. Our evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, while task updates and human interaction remain difficult. Frequent collisions and falls further motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success, even with a shared action interface and decision budget.

摘要（中文）：机器人必须在物理和社会约束下行动，同时适应环境变化和人类需求。现有的具身智能体系统往往聚焦于特定目标或将执行抽象为符号动作，限制了在不断演变的世界中的评估。我们提出TARSphere，一个面向机器人的全栈框架，用于物理和社会层面具身化的长时程具身智能体。TARSphere-Infra在带有具身NPC和受限对话的物理模拟器中运行机器人策略。事件驱动的有限状态机（FSM）利用已完成的动作和传递的信息来更新任务状态并评估结果。TARSphere-Harness作为其具身大脑控制器，使冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够通过多层级可执行技能行动，利用观测、分层记忆和执行反馈来修正决策。在此基础上，智能体在环策展对齐任务语义、因果依赖和场景几何，构建TARSphere-Bench：涵盖30个室内场景中的360个片段。五种配对条件评估导航报告和取送任务中的感知鲁棒性、干扰适应、任务更新、人类协作和意图理解。我们对8个MLLM的评估表明，通用模型可以超越具身模型，而任务更新和人类交互仍然具有挑战性。频繁的碰撞和跌倒进一步促使在执行成功之外评估执行安全性，即使在共享动作接口和决策预算的情况下也是如此。

Authors: Yicheng Xu, Zhikai Xu, Ziyuan Chen, Yuhang Dong, Tao Zhang, Zhucun Xue, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang

Object- and Task-Aware Active Perception for Safe Navigation of Mobile Manipulators in Semi-Static Environments Manipulation

active perception next-best-view mobile manipulator model predictive control safe navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种移动机械臂的主动感知框架，通过将下一最佳视角公式集成到分层任务模型预测控制中，在导航过程中检查不确定或安全关键区域，从而在半静态环境中提高地图一致性并降低导航风险。

TLDR: This paper presents an active perception framework for mobile manipulators that uses a next-best-view formulation integrated into hierarchical-task model predictive control to inspect uncertain or safety-critical regions during navigation, improving map consistency and reducing navigation risk in semi-static environments.

Abstract: Mobile manipulators must navigate safely in cluttered, partially unknown environments across logistics, manufacturing, and service applications. Semi-static changes between robot visits can lead to outdated scene knowledge and increased collision risk. We propose an active perception framework that enables a high degree-of-freedom (DoF) mobile manipulator to inspect uncertain or safety-critical regions with its hand camera during navigation. A probabilistic, object- and task-aware next-best-view (NBV) formulation prioritizes observations near the desired path and around uncertain or potentially changing objects. The perception objective is integrated into hierarchical-task model predictive control (HTMPC), exploiting kinematic redundancy for viewpoint adjustment while preserving the higher priority of base-trajectory tracking. The system unifies navigation, map maintenance, and active perception in a closed loop. Real-world tests show improved map consistency, reduced task-dependent map entropy, and lower navigation risk than passive or non-task-aware baselines. Additional simulation and real-world sequences demonstrate responses to controlled semi-static scene changes.

摘要（中文）：移动操作机器人在物流、制造及服务应用中，必须能够在杂乱且部分未知的环境中安全导航。机器人两次访问之间发生的半静态变化可能导致场景信息过时，从而增加碰撞风险。我们提出了一种主动感知框架，使高自由度（DoF）移动操作机器人能够在导航过程中利用其手部相机检查不确定或安全关键区域。该框架采用一种概率性的、面向对象且任务感知的下一最佳视角（NBV）公式，优先对期望路径附近以及不确定或可能变化的物体周围进行观测。感知目标被集成到分层任务模型预测控制（HTMPC）中，利用运动学冗余进行视角调整，同时保持基座轨迹跟踪的更高优先级。该系统在闭环中统一了导航、地图维护与主动感知。实际测试表明，与被动基线或非任务感知基线相比，地图一致性有所提高，任务相关地图熵降低，导航风险减小。额外的仿真与真实世界序列实验展示了对受控半静态场景变化的响应能力。

Authors: Jingxing Qian, Xintong Du, Jun Yang, Siqi Zhou, Steven L. Waslander, Angela P. Schoellig

RangeNav: Task-Aligned LiDAR Range-Image Pretraining for Robot Navigation RLRobot

LiDAR range-image pretraining reinforcement learning robot navigation quadruped

简要说明：RangeNav 提出了一种在合成数据上预训练的紧凑型 LiDAR 距离图像编码器，并通过导航对齐的目标函数，提升了四足机器人在密集人群中的强化学习导航性能，并实现了真实世界部署。

TLDR: RangeNav introduces a compact LiDAR range-image encoder pretrained on synthetic data with a navigation-aligned objective, improving RL-based navigation for quadruped robots in dense crowds and real-world deployment.

Abstract: Autonomous mobile robots operating in dense crowds and cluttered sites require $360^\circ$ perception to react to surrounding hazards. While panoramic LiDAR offers full-surround coverage, learning representations within reinforcement learning (RL) is sample-inefficient under sparse rewards, and existing 3D pretrained point-cloud encoders are too memory-heavy for massively parallel RL simulation. We present RangeNav, a compact (183k parameters) LiDAR range-image encoder pretrained entirely on synthetic data. RangeNav uses anisotropic convolutions and circular padding to handle the extreme aspect ratio and azimuthal seam of range images. We pretrain the network using a navigation-aligned objective combining range reconstruction, semantic segmentation, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) prediction, then freeze it for policy learning. In simulation, adding semantic and BEV supervision increases success rates over a reconstruction-only baseline by an average of 32.03 and 23.73 percentage points (pp) in procedurally generated training and out-of-distribution realistic test environments, respectively. Zero-shot real-world deployments on a Unitree B2-W quadruped demonstrate robust navigation through dense crowds, low-light settings, and construction zones where limited-field-of-view depth policies struggle. Code and models will be open-sourced. Project website: https://rangenav.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：在密集人群和杂乱场地中运行的自主移动机器人需要$360^\circ$感知能力，以便对周围危险做出及时反应。尽管全景激光雷达可提供全方位覆盖，但在强化学习（RL）框架下，基于稀疏奖励学习表征的样本效率较低，且现有3D预训练点云编码器对于大规模并行RL仿真而言内存开销过大。我们提出RangeNav——一种紧凑型（183k参数）LiDAR距离图像编码器，完全在合成数据上完成预训练。RangeNav采用各向异性卷积和循环填充，以应对距离图像极端的宽高比和方位接缝问题。我们使用一种导航对齐的预训练目标对网络进行预训练，该目标融合了距离重建、语义分割和鸟瞰图（BEV）预测，并在预训练后冻结网络以进行策略学习。在仿真中，加入语义和BEV监督相比仅重建的基线，在程序化生成的训练环境和分布外真实感测试环境中，平均成功率分别提高了32.03和23.73个百分点（pp）。在Unitree B2-W四足机器人上的零样本真实世界部署展示了其在密集人群、低光照环境和施工区域中的鲁棒导航能力，而这些场景中有限视场角的深度策略往往表现不佳。代码和模型将开源。项目网站：https://rangenav.github.io/。

Spacetime Splines for Adaptive Robot Motions Manipulation

spline-based motion primitives Bezier curve alternating optimization online retiming patient-turning task

简要说明：本文提出一种基于样条的机器人运动表示方法，将空间几何与时间进程统一表示，支持自适应的模型复杂度与在线重定时，并在物理人体模型的患者翻身任务中验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a spline-based motion representation that jointly captures spatial geometry and temporal progression for robot motions, enabling adaptive complexity and online retiming, demonstrated in a patient-turning task with a physical manikin.

Abstract: Movement primitives commonly represent robot mo- tions through basis functions indexed by time or phase. Inspired by spacetime representations employed in physics, we propose a spline-based formulation in which spatial geometry and temporal progression are represented within a common set of continuous variables. The proposed method jointly estimates a shared Bezier curve, while allowing spatial and temporal model complexity to be adapted independently (e.g., demonstration-specific phase modulation). As use case, we consider an alternating optimization process that simultaneously estimates path intervals observed in partial demonstrations. Simulation experiments demonstrate accurate joint recovery, refinement through modifications in model complexity and continuity, and improved robustness to variance in the demonstration set. Finally, we demonstrate online retiming and synchronization capabilities in a patient-turning task assisted by a robot, evaluated with a physical manikin.

摘要（中文）：运动原语通常通过以时间或相位为索引的基函数来表示机器人运动。受物理学中时空表示的启发，我们提出了一种基于样条的公式，在该公式中，空间几何和时间进程在共同的一组连续变量中表示。所提出的方法联合估计一条共享的贝塞尔曲线，同时允许空间和时间模型的复杂度独立调整（例如，针对特定演示的相位调制）。作为用例，我们考虑了一种交替优化过程，该过程同时估计部分演示中观察到的路径区间。仿真实验证明了联合恢复的准确性、通过模型复杂度和连续性修改实现的细化，以及对演示集方差鲁棒性的提升。最后，我们在机器人辅助的患者翻身任务中展示了在线重定时和同步能力，并使用物理人体模型进行了评估。

Authors: Boxuan Zhang, Ante Marić, Sylvain Calinon

Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI RLRobot

recursive self-improvement robot learning manipulation learning to learn safety

简要说明：本文将递归自我改进（RSI）定位在机器人学习中，回顾了现有研究并提出了评估原则，以指导未来机器安全改进自身改进过程的研究。

TLDR: This paper positions recursive self-improvement (RSI) within robot learning, reviewing existing studies and proposing evaluation principles to guide future research on machines that safely improve their own improvement processes.

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. We position RSI within robot learning and trace pathways from improving robot capabilities to improving the processes that generate them. We examine how physical experience can strengthen these improvement mechanisms and when the resulting gains can support further self-improvement of the mechanisms themselves. Gains carry forward only when feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, benefits to later learning, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change the improver's knowledge or tools, but the physical studies reviewed here have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion. We synthesize these findings into evaluation principles and research directions for machines that, trial by trial, safely improve the way they improve.

摘要（中文）：递归式自我改进（RSI）描述了一种系统，它不仅改进自身行为，还改进其进行改进的过程。近期的数字智能体通过重写自身代码并用可执行测试检验每个版本来验证这一理念。将这些机制引入物理世界，需要在代价高昂的试验中从部分观测中学习，同时考虑不断变化的运行条件以及潜在的不可逆后果。我们将RSI置于机器人学习的框架中，梳理从提升机器人能力到改进产生这些能力的过程的路径。我们考察物理经验如何强化这些改进机制，以及由此产生的收益何时能够支持这些机制自身的进一步改进。只有当反馈针对尚存的学习需求、接收组件能够利用该变化、其价值在任务或硬件变化中得以保留，并且持续实践仍然安全且可负担时，收益才能得以延续。现有研究主要集中在操作领域，支持行为改进、对后续学习的益处以及程序改进。一些系统也改变了改进者的知识或工具，但本文所综述的物理研究尚未分离出可归因于递归的收益。我们将这些发现综合为评估原则和研究方向，以指导机器在一次次试验中安全地改进其自身的改进方式。

Authors: Meng Luo, Zechen Bai, Shanqing Xu, Yanlin Li, Kaixin Li, Mengchen Qian, Weifeng Lu, Ran Zhang, Yingtian Zou, Ziyang Luo, Wei Chen, Hongzhan Lin

DriveMLP: When Training Strategy Outperforms Model Complexity in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

closed-loop imitation learning Expert-Guided RL nuPlan benchmark MLP policy trajectory-distance reward

简要说明：DriveMLP表明在闭环自动驾驶中，精心设计的模仿学习训练策略（专家引导强化学习）可以让简单的MLP策略达到最先进的性能，超越Flow Planner等更复杂的模型。

TLDR: DriveMLP shows that in closed-loop autonomous driving, a carefully designed imitation learning training strategy (Expert-Guided RL) can achieve state-of-the-art performance with a simple MLP policy, outperforming more complex models like Flow Planner.

Abstract: Learning motion planning policies that remain reliable under closed-loop execution is a central challenge in Autonomous Driving (AD). Imitation Learning (IL) scales well to large AD datasets but suffers from distribution shift, causal confusion, and compounding errors under closed-loop execution. In contrast, Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically requires handcrafted rule-based rewards and massive simulation. We study a simple closed-loop IL framework that uses RL purely as an optimization tool, guided by a trajectory-distance reward derived from logged expert data. We refer to this training strategy as Expert-Guided RL (EGRL). Through a controlled empirical study we find evidence that the training procedure, rather than model size and complexity, accounts for a substantial part of the performance gains. We then introduce DriveMLP, a lightweight MLP policy trained with EGRL, as a simple instantiation of these findings. It achieves a score of 86.51 on the nuPlan Val14 Reactive benchmark, a +3.2 point improvement over the previous best IL planner (Flow Planner), with >15x faster inference. Code is available at: https://github.com/alessandro-canevaro/DriveMLP .

摘要（中文）：学习在闭环执行下保持可靠性的运动规划策略，是自动驾驶（AD）领域的一项核心挑战。模仿学习（IL）能够很好地扩展到大规模自动驾驶数据集，但在闭环执行下却面临分布偏移、因果混淆以及误差累积等问题。相比之下，强化学习（RL）通常需要手工设计的基于规则的奖励函数以及大规模的仿真环境。我们研究了一种简单的闭环模仿学习框架，该框架仅将强化学习作为优化工具，并以来自记录的专家数据所导出的轨迹距离奖励作为引导。我们将这种训练策略称为专家引导的强化学习（EGRL）。通过一项受控的实证研究，我们发现证据表明，训练过程本身，而非模型规模与复杂度，对性能提升的贡献占据了主要部分。随后，我们提出了DriveMLP——一种使用EGRL训练的轻量级MLP策略，作为上述发现的一个简单实例化。该模型在nuPlan Val14反应式基准测试中取得了86.51的分数，较之前最优的IL规划器（Flow Planner）提升了3.2分，且推理速度提高了15倍以上。代码已开源，见：https://github.com/alessandro-canevaro/DriveMLP 。

Authors: Alessandro Canevaro, Julian Schmidt, Hang Yu, Ye Jin, Sajad Marvi, Georg Martius, Julian Jordan

End-to-End Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Jumping in Lunar Gravity Locomotion

quadrupedal jumping lunar gravity reinforcement learning end-to-end policy hardware transfer

简要说明：本文提出了一种多阶段强化学习方法，用于在月球重力下实现四足机器人点到点跳跃的单一端到端控制策略，并在仿真和硬件实验中验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper presents a multistage reinforcement learning approach for a single end-to-end control policy enabling quadrupedal point-to-point jumping in lunar gravity, with simulation validation and hardware transfer under gravity offloading.

Abstract: Legged robots can extend planetary exploration to rugged and discontinuous terrain that is inaccessible to conventional rovers. In lunar gravity, jumping further expands this mobility by enabling robots to cross obstacles and gaps that cannot be traversed by walking alone. We present a multistage reinforcement-learning approach that produces a single end-to-end control policy for commanded point-to-point jumping under lunar gravity. The resulting policy has a simple architecture and relies exclusively on mission-compatible onboard sensing, making its deployment on a real lunar mission plausible. In simulation, the learned policy performs accurate point-to-point jumps with landing errors smaller than the robot's body size. We analyze the torque and power demands of lunar jumping and characterize performance degradation under extreme outlier events, including control-update freezes of up to \SI{1}{s} during flight. Hardware transfer demonstrates that the policy can successfully execute a vertical jump under lunar-gravity offloading. Furthermore, the measured torque and power profiles are consistent with the simulation results and remain within the robot's hardware limits.

摘要（中文）：腿式机器人能够将行星探索扩展至传统巡视车无法进入的崎岖和不连续地形。在月球重力环境下，跳跃进一步扩展了这种机动能力，使机器人能够跨越仅靠行走无法通过的障碍物和间隙。我们提出了一种多阶段强化学习方法，该方法生成一个端到端控制策略，用于在月球重力下执行指令指定的点对点跳跃。所得策略具有简单的架构，并且完全依赖与任务兼容的机载传感，使其在实际月球任务中的部署具有可行性。在仿真中，学习到的策略能够执行精确的点对点跳跃，着陆误差小于机器人本体的尺寸。我们分析了月球跳跃的扭矩和功率需求，并刻画了在极端异常事件下的性能退化，包括飞行期间长达1秒的控制更新冻结。硬件迁移实验表明，该策略能够在月球重力卸载条件下成功执行垂直跳跃。此外，测得的扭矩和功率曲线与仿真结果一致，并且保持在机器人的硬件限制范围内。

Authors: Levin Müller, Oliver Fischer, Marco Trentini, Yusuke Tanaka, Marco Hutter

Joint-Angle Invariance of Jacobian-Based Performance Indices for Serial Robotic Manipulators Manipulation

joint-angle invariance Jacobian-based performance indices manipulability workspace performance map task layout optimization

简要说明：本文确定了串联机械臂中基于雅可比矩阵的性能指标的关节角不变性运动学条件，从而允许降低维度的性能评估，并应用于工作空间映射和任务布局优化。

TLDR: This paper identifies kinematic conditions for joint-angle invariance of Jacobian-based performance indices in serial manipulators, enabling reduced-dimensionality performance evaluation with applications in workspace mapping and task layout optimization.

Abstract: This article investigates the joint-angle invariance (JAI) of Jacobian-based performance indices for serial robotic manipulators. We identify kinematic conditions under which representative performance indices, including manipulability, stiffness, and other Jacobian-derived indices, remain independent of the first and last joint angles. This property allows a systematic reduction in the effective configuration-space dimensionality, thereby simplifying the performance evaluation. The utility of JAI is demonstrated through two application scenarios: workspace performance map construction and task layout optimization. Comparative results show that the proposed JAI-based strategy reduces computational effort and storage requirements without compromising the effectiveness.

摘要（中文）：本文研究了串联机械臂中基于雅可比矩阵的性能指标对关节角度的不变性。我们识别了在何种运动学条件下，代表性性能指标（包括可操作性、刚度及其他由雅可比矩阵导出的指标）能够独立于首尾关节角度。这一特性使得有效构型空间维度得以系统性缩减，从而简化了性能评估过程。通过两个应用场景——工作空间性能图谱构建与任务布局优化——展示了关节角度不变性的实用价值。对比结果表明，所提出的基于关节角度不变性的策略在降低计算负担与存储需求的同时，并未牺牲其有效性。

Authors: Yaohua Zhou, Mingdao Lin, Jiayu Song, Xixin Zhao, Haidong Huang, Jiahu Qin, Xiaocong Li

Mixture of Flow Matching and Particle Filter for Proprioception-Based Online Contact Estimation Manipulation

contact estimation flow matching particle filter proprioception manipulator

简要说明：ContactFlowFilter 将流匹配生成模型集成到粒子滤波器框架中，用于机器人操作器的基于本体感觉的接触估计，实现多模态信念跟踪和接触事件检测。

TLDR: ContactFlowFilter integrates flow matching generative models into a particle filter framework for proprioception-based contact estimation on robot manipulators, enabling multi-modal belief tracking and contact event detection in real time.

Abstract: In this article, we propose ContactFlowFilter, a novel approach for contact estimation that determines the number of active contacts, their locations, and the associated force vectors. We consider a robot manipulator equipped with joint torque sensors and a base force/torque sensor; such a proprioceptive-only setup presents a challenging inverse problem characterized by (i) multi-modality from non-unique solutions, (ii) temporal dependencies in state evolution, and (iii) discrete contact events involving contact addition/removal. Existing approaches, such as particle filters (PFs) and learning-based methods, often struggle to address these challenges simultaneously. To overcome this, ContactFlowFilter integrates a generative model into the PF framework. The recursive structure of the PF captures temporal dependencies, while the flow matching model serves as an auxiliary proposal distribution to track multi-modal beliefs and detect contact events. Extensive validation in both simulation and real-world experiments confirms the effectiveness of the proposed method. In real-world settings, ContactFlowFilter achieves the lowest dissimilarity from the target distribution, with errors of only 0.36 cm and 0.88 cm for single- and dual-contact scenarios, respectively, while operating at 0.69 ms and 2.69 ms.

摘要（中文）：在本文中，我们提出了ContactFlowFilter，一种新颖的接触估计方法，用于确定活跃接触点的数量、位置及相关力向量。我们考虑配备关节扭矩传感器和基座力/扭矩传感器的机器人操作臂；这种仅依赖本体感觉的配置呈现出一个具有挑战性的逆问题，其特征包括：（i）由非唯一解导致的多模态性，（ii）状态演化中的时间依赖性，以及（iii）涉及接触添加/移除的离散接触事件。现有方法，如粒子滤波器（PFs）和基于学习的方法，往往难以同时应对这些挑战。为解决这一问题，ContactFlowFilter将生成模型集成到PF框架中。PF的递归结构捕捉时间依赖性，而流匹配模型作为辅助提议分布，用于跟踪多模态信念并检测接触事件。在仿真和实际实验中的广泛验证证实了所提出方法的有效性。在实际环境中，ContactFlowFilter实现了与目标分布的最低差异度，单接触和双接触场景下的误差分别仅为0.36厘米和0.88厘米，同时运行时间分别为0.69毫秒和2.69毫秒。

Authors: Seo Wook Han, Min Jun Kim

Preserving Operator Intent Under Actuation Constraints: Teleoperation of Manipulators with Coupled Transmissions Manipulation

teleoperation actuator constraints coupled transmissions differential wrist robot manipulators

简要说明：本文提出一种考虑执行器约束的主从遥操作方法，用于耦合传动机械臂，通过协调电机饱和与可行参考更新，在真实机器人实验中保留了操作意图并改善了手腕轨迹平滑性。

TLDR: This paper proposes an actuator-constraint-aware teleoperation method for manipulators with coupled transmissions, addressing coordinated motor saturation and recovery transients to preserve operator intent and improve wrist trajectory smoothness in real-robot experiments.

Abstract: Teleoperation enables intuitive control of remote engineering robots for precision tasks. Existing direct joint-mapping methods have two limitations: independent motor saturation disrupts pitch-roll coordination in differential wrists, while fixed mappings struggle with abrupt tracking changes caused by gravitational loads and actuation constraints. We propose an actuator-constraint-aware leader-follower teleoperation method that jointly models leader gravity compensation, leader-follower joint mapping, and follower differential-wrist control. Specifically, we perform coordinated saturation in motor space according to the available gravity margin and integrate continuous angle unwrapping, feedback-state monitoring, and feasible-reference updates. This preserves the operator's motion direction, reduces coordination distortion, and suppresses recovery transients during saturation or brief communication failures. Real-robot experiments demonstrate smoother wrist trajectories and more continuous recovery than direct mapping.

摘要（中文）：遥操作技术能够实现对远程工程机器人的直观控制，以完成精密任务。现有的直接关节映射方法存在两个局限性：独立电机饱和会破坏差速腕部的俯仰-滚转协调性，而固定映射难以应对由重力负载和执行机构约束引起的突然跟踪变化。本文提出了一种考虑执行机构约束的主从遥操作方法，该方法联合建模了主端重力补偿、主从关节映射以及从端差速腕部控制。具体而言，我们根据可用的重力裕度在电机空间内进行协调饱和处理，并集成连续角度展开、反馈状态监测和可行参考更新。该方法能够保持操作者的运动方向，减少协调失真，并抑制饱和或短暂通信故障期间的恢复瞬态。真实机器人实验表明，与直接映射相比，该方法实现了更平滑的腕部轨迹和更连续的恢复过程。

Authors: Xuhan Miao, Zijin Han, Yutong Shen, Haidong Huang, Shanliushui Gao, Lei Zhang, Xiaocong Li, Chenguang Yang

Make it Walk: Computational Design of LEGO Walkers Locomotion

LEGO walkers computational design morphology and control co-design non-circular gears gait generation

简要说明：本文提出首个计算方法，通过协同优化形态与控制，设计具有稳定运动和多种步态的乐高行走机器人，使用带有3D打印非圆齿轮的齿轮连杆机构和独立电机控制。

TLDR: This paper presents the first computational method to design LEGO walkers with stable locomotion and multiple gaits by co-optimizing morphology and control, using gear-linkage mechanisms with 3D-printed non-circular gears and independent motor control.

Abstract: LEGO walkers are walking automata constructed from modular LEGO Technic bricks. They exhibit intriguing locomotion and are also highly reconfigurable through the modular Technic bricks, making them widely applicable in education, recreation, and robotics research. However, existing LEGO walkers are designed mostly by reusing existing single-actuator walking mechanisms. Although the locomotion is stable, their fixed walking gaits limit their adaptability and versatility. This paper presents the first computational solution capable of designing LEGO walkers that not only walk stably, but also support a variety of walking gaits. Our idea is twofold. First, we control the foot motion trajectory of each leg mechanically via a specifically-designed gear-linkage mechanism, in which we incorporate a pair of 3D-printed non-circular gears to work with a LEGO Technic mechanism. Second, we drive each leg by an independent motor and synchronize the timings of multiple leg motions via a simple yet adaptable control algorithm, enabling stable and versatile locomotion. Importantly, we take this modeling as a foundation to co-design the morphology and control of the LEGO walkers to meet the target locomotion and appearance. Leveraging our approach, we created a variety of LEGO walkers, demonstrating various walking gaits and appearances, and fabricated some of them to show their locomotion capability in the real world.

摘要（中文）：乐高步行机是由模块化乐高Technic积木构建的行走自动机。它们展现出引人入胜的运动能力，并且通过模块化Technic积木具有高度的可重构性，使其广泛应用于教育、娱乐和机器人研究领域。然而，现有的乐高步行机大多通过复用单一执行器的行走机构进行设计。尽管其运动稳定性良好，但固定的行走步态限制了其适应性和多功能性。本文提出了首个计算解决方案，能够设计不仅行走稳定，而且支持多种行走步态的乐高步行机。我们的思路包含两个方面。首先，我们通过专门设计的齿轮连杆机构机械性地控制每条腿的足部运动轨迹，其中集成了一对3D打印的非圆齿轮，与乐高Technic机构协同工作。其次，我们使用独立电机驱动每条腿，并通过一种简单但可适应的控制算法同步多条腿运动的时序，从而实现稳定且多变的运动能力。重要的是，我们以此建模为基础，对乐高步行机的形态和控制进行协同设计，以满足目标运动方式和外观要求。借助我们的方法，我们创建了多种乐高步行机，展示了不同的行走步态和外观，并实际制造了其中一些，以验证其在现实世界中的运动能力。

Authors: Siqi Li, Fancheng Gao, Chi-Wing Fu, Peng Song

S-Rolling: Steerable Rolling Gaits for Twistable Snake Robots in Low-Clearance Environments Locomotion

snake robot steerable rolling gait low-clearance locomotion twistable snake kinematic model

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于可扭转蛇形机器人的可转向滚动步态 S-rolling，在保持低轮廓高度的同时实现平面内转向，并在真机上验证了低净空场景下的机动能力。

TLDR: This paper presents S-rolling, a steerable rolling gait for twistable snake robots that maintains low swept height while enabling planar heading changes in low-clearance environments, validated on real hardware.

Abstract: Snake robots can traverse complex environments with limbless locomotion, but maneuvering in low-clearance environments remains challenging because a gait must maintain a small swept height while also providing planar steering. Existing rolling gaits preserve a low swept height body configuration but generally provide limited steering, whereas steering gaits often introduce vertical undulation and require additional clearance. With that in mind, this paper develops S-rolling, a steerable rolling gait that combines low swept height locomotion with planar maneuverability for twistable snake robots. S-rolling is designed using an S-shaped planar backbone curve, whose head and tail segments roll with independently controlled angular velocities, producing different motion modes. We derive its joint space gait equation, in which a central twist joint realizes the relative rotation between the two segments. We also develop a quasi-static kinematic model relating the segment rolling speeds to the linear and angular velocities of the robot. Real-robot experiments demonstrate the various motion modes, traversal through a 10 cm clearance test track, and maneuvering tasks beneath a large workpiece and a car chassis. In these low-clearance scenarios, S-rolling successfully performs approximately 90$^\circ$ and 180$^\circ$ heading changes, whereas the baseline rolling arc gait cannot change the robot heading.

摘要（中文）：蛇形机器人能够凭借无肢运动穿越复杂环境，但在低净空环境中机动仍然具有挑战性，因为步态必须保持较小的扫过高度，同时还需提供平面转向能力。现有滚动步态能够保持低扫过高度的身体构型，但通常转向能力有限，而转向步态往往引入垂直起伏，需要额外净空。基于此，本文开发了S-rolling，一种可转向滚动步态，将低扫过高度运动与平面机动能力相结合，适用于可扭转蛇形机器人。S-rolling采用S形平面脊柱曲线设计，其头部和尾部节段以独立控制的角速度滚动，产生不同的运动模式。我们推导了其关节空间步态方程，其中中央扭转关节实现两节段之间的相对旋转。我们还建立了一个准静态运动学模型，将节段滚动速度与机器人的线速度和角速度关联起来。真实机器人实验展示了多种运动模式、穿越10厘米净空测试轨道的能力，以及在大型工件和汽车底盘下方执行机动任务的表现。在这些低净空场景中，S-rolling成功实现了约90°和180°的航向变化，而基线滚动弧形步态则无法改变机器人航向。

Authors: Qingling Fan, Zhongqiang Ren

Linear Twisting Sidewinding Gaits for Twistable Snake Robot Motion Planning on Complex Terrains Locomotion

snake robot sidewinding gait twisting motion motion planning complex terrains

简要说明：本文提出了一类新的蛇形机器人扭动侧行步态，将负载分布到整个身体，使单个关节峰值功率降低42%，并能在复杂地形上移动，速度比传统侧行快49%。

TLDR: This paper introduces a new family of twisting sidewinding gaits for snake robots that distribute the workload over the entire body, reducing peak motor power by 42% and enabling locomotion on complex terrains while achieving up to 49% faster speeds than conventional sidewinding.

Abstract: Sidewinding is an efficient gait for snake robots to locomote on various terrains, by undulating the backbone curve and shifting the contact segments along it. However, relying solely on undulatory motion limits the locomotive capability of snake robots, and combining it with twisting motion can improve their speed and robustness. This hypothesis has recently been verified by the rolling vector approach, which locomotes the robot like a differential-drive car. Yet its twisting is concentrated in a short buffer segment, imposing most of the workload on the two twist joints in the middle, which can often overburden the motors and limit its locomotion. With that in mind, this paper develops a new family of twisting sidewinding gaits that distribute the workload over the entire body with our proposed linear twisting function. Under matched turning speed and total output power, our gaits reduce the peak output power of a single twist joint by 42%. Real-robot experiments show that, with the reduced workload, our new gaits can locomote the robot in various terrains that the existing rolling vector approach cannot. Besides, our new gaits can move up to 49% faster than conventional sidewinding without twisting.

摘要（中文）：侧行运动是一种高效的运动步态，蛇形机器人通过背脊曲线的波动并沿其移动接触段，能够在多种地形上实现移动。然而，仅依靠波动运动限制了蛇形机器人的移动能力，而将波动运动与扭转运动相结合可提高其速度和鲁棒性。这一假设最近通过滚动向量方法得到了验证，该方法使机器人像差速驱动车辆一样移动。然而，其扭转集中在一个较短的缓冲段中，将大部分工作负荷施加在中间的两个扭转关节上，这常常会使电机过载并限制其运动。基于此，本文开发了一类新的扭转侧行运动步态，通过我们提出的线性扭转函数将工作负荷分布到整个身体上。在匹配的转弯速度和总输出功率下，我们的步态将单个扭转关节的峰值输出功率降低了42%。真实机器人实验表明，在工作负荷降低的情况下，我们的新步态能使机器人在现有滚动向量方法无法实现的多种地形上移动。此外，我们的新步态比无扭转的传统侧行运动速度可提高高达49%。

Authors: Qingling Fan, Zhongqiang Ren

Integrating Flow Matching and Model Predictive Control for Safe Robot Navigation Other

flow matching model predictive control path planning collision avoidance mobile robot navigation

简要说明：该论文将流匹配路径规划与模型预测控制相结合，以实现满足约束且无碰撞的移动机器人导航，并通过事件触发的重规划来适应未见过的障碍物。

TLDR: This paper integrates flow-matching-based path planning with model predictive control to enable constraint-aware and collision-free mobile robot navigation, using event-triggered replanning to adapt to unseen obstacles.

Abstract: Learning-based path planners based on diffusion and flow matching can generate diverse trajectories from demonstrations but typically lack mechanisms for constraint satisfaction and collision avoidance during deployment. This work proposes a framework that combines flow-matching-based path planning with model predictive path-following control to integrate data-driven path generation with real-time, constraint-aware execution. The flow-matching model captures multimodal path distributions, while the predictive controller adapts motion online to satisfy state and input constraints and avoid obstacles using updated local sensor information. An event-triggered re-planning scheme incorporates predictive control solutions into subsequent path generation, promoting collision-free navigation in environments with previously unseen obstacles. Simulation results for mobile robot navigation demonstrate robust performance across cluttered environments. The framework provides a systematic approach to combining flow matching with predictive control for adaptive, data-driven navigation.

摘要（中文）：基于扩散和流匹配的学习型路径规划器能够从示范中生成多样化轨迹，但在部署过程中通常缺乏约束满足和碰撞避免机制。本文提出了一种将基于流匹配的路径规划与模型预测路径跟踪控制相结合的框架，以整合数据驱动的路径生成与实时、考虑约束的执行过程。流匹配模型捕捉多模态路径分布，而预测控制器则利用更新的局部传感器信息在线调整运动，以满足状态和输入约束并避开障碍物。一种事件触发的重新规划方案将预测控制解引入后续路径生成中，促进在存在未见障碍物的环境中实现无碰撞导航。移动机器人导航的仿真结果表明，该框架在杂乱环境中表现出鲁棒性能。该框架提供了一种系统性的方法，将流匹配与预测控制相结合，用于自适应、数据驱动的导航。

Authors: Philipp Holzmann, Maik Pfefferkorn, Joao Carvalho, Ali Younes, An Thai Le, Georgia Chalvatzaki, Jan Peters, Rolf Findeisen

Alpha: Systematic Fault Injection and Robustness Evaluation for LLM-Driven Embodied Manipulation Manipulation

fault injection robustness evaluation LLM-driven manipulation simulation planner-output corruption

简要说明：Alpha 是一个用于仿真环境中 LLM 驱动具身操作的故障注入与鲁棒性评估框架，通过系统性分离物理、运动学失效与规划层问题，证明 LLM 规划器仅在规划输出损坏时明显劣于确定性的 Oracle 规划器，而非因为认知推理缺陷。

TLDR: Alpha is a fault-injection and robustness-evaluation framework for LLM-driven embodied manipulation in simulation, which systematically separates physical and kinematic failure causes from planner-level issues, showing that LLM planners underperform a deterministic oracle only under planner-output corruption, not due to cognitive reasoning deficits.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into embodied robotic planning, yet standard benchmarks primarily evaluate end-to-end task completion in nominal environments, obscuring failure origins across the execution stack. We present Alpha, a systematic fault-injection and robustness-evaluation framework for LLM-driven manipulation in simulation. Alpha injects calibrated faults across perception (sensor lag), actuation (grip slip), kinematics (unreachable targets), and planning (planner-output corruption), alongside concurrent conditions. To separate physical vulnerabilities from planner sensitivities, we introduce a matched methodology pairing an LLM agent (Llama-3 via Ollama) against a deterministic Scripted Oracle planner across a balanced 150-episode matrix under identical seeds, geometries, and safety criteria. Across the matrix, the Oracle achieves 64.0% (48/75) success while the LLM achieves 44.0% (33/75) (paired McNemar p = 3.01 x 10^-4). Crucially, excluding planner-output corruption, performance across all physical and kinematic conditions is identical: 55.0% (33/60) for both planners with zero discordant pairs (McNemar p = 1.00). This demonstrates that physical actuator slip, kinematic reach boundaries, and perceptual staleness affect deterministic controllers and LLM planners equivalently. The performance gap is driven entirely by planner-output corruption (100% Oracle vs. 0% LLM), isolating the prompt-to-JSON serialization and validation interface rather than a cognitive reasoning deficit. We also audit 169 historical pilot attempts for transparency.

摘要（中文）：大语言模型（LLMs）正日益融入具身机器人规划中，然而现有标准基准主要评估标称环境下的端到端任务完成情况，难以揭示执行栈中各环节的失败根源。我们提出Alpha，一个面向仿真环境中LLM驱动操作任务的系统性故障注入与鲁棒性评估框架。Alpha在感知（传感器延迟）、执行（夹爪滑移）、运动学（不可达目标）及规划（规划器输出损坏）层面注入校准故障，并同时考虑并发条件。为区分物理层面的脆弱性与规划器层面的敏感性，我们引入一种配对方法，将LLM智能体（通过Ollama运行的Llama-3）与确定性脚本Oracle规划器在相同种子、几何场景及安全准则下，于150个平衡设计的测试场景矩阵中进行对比。在整个矩阵中，Oracle达到64.0%（48/75）的成功率，而LLM为44.0%（33/75）（配对McNemar检验p = 3.01 x 10^-4）。关键在于，排除规划器输出损坏条件后，所有物理与运动学条件下的性能完全一致：两种规划器均为55.0%（33/60），且无不一致配对（McNemar p = 1.00）。这表明物理执行滑移、运动学可达边界及感知信息滞后对确定性控制器与LLM规划器的影响是等同的。性能差距完全由规划器输出损坏条件所致（Oracle为100%，LLM为0%），从而将问题根源锁定在提示到JSON的序列化及验证接口，而非认知推理缺陷。我们还对169次历史试验尝试进行了透明度审计。

Authors: Jona Joy

How Representational Priors Shape Generalization in World Action Models WorldModel

world action models representational prior nuisance orthogonality generalization policy learning

简要说明：本文研究了世界动作模型（WAM）中生成式骨干网络的表征先验如何影响泛化性能，提出用干扰正交性来预测对视觉变化的鲁棒性，并分析了鲁棒WAM如何抑制干扰特征。

TLDR: This paper investigates how the representational priors of generative backbones in world action models (WAMs) affect generalization, proposing nuisance orthogonality as a metric that predicts robustness to visual variations and analyzing how robust WAMs suppress nuisance features.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) are shown to substantially diverge under generalization performance based on their generative backbones. We investigate this gap through the representational geometry that WAMs inherit from their backbones and how policy training reorganizes it. Our central hypothesis is that a useful representational prior would structure geometry that separates nuisance information from the in-distribution manifold in advance of training as a policy. We quantify this with nuisance orthogonality; orthogonality of the feature under visual variation outside the empirical in-distribution manifold. Across various image and video backbones, we show that a higher orthogonality from the representational prior is associated with stronger robustness to visual variations after WAM training, enabling policy generalization measurable prospectively for world models. In addition, analyzing the resulting robust WAMs reveals nuisance suppression; relative suppression of feature displacement caused by such variations and robust action generation of the policy. Together, these findings provide a geometric perspective on how the representational prior of the world model shapes the generalization performance of WAMs.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAMs）被证明在基于其生成骨干网络的泛化性能上存在显著差异。我们通过WAMs从其骨干网络中继承的表征几何结构，以及策略训练如何重组这一结构，来探究这一差异。我们的核心假设是，一个有用的表征先验会在策略训练之前，预先构建一种能够将干扰信息与分布内流形分离开来的几何结构。我们通过干扰正交性来量化这一点，即在经验分布内流形之外的视觉变化下特征的正交性。在多种图像和视频骨干网络上，我们表明，表征先验具有更高的正交性与WAM训练后对视觉变化更强的鲁棒性相关联，从而能够对世界模型实现前瞻性的策略泛化度量。此外，对所得鲁棒WAMs的分析揭示了干扰抑制，即由这些变化引起的特征位移的相对抑制，以及策略的鲁棒动作生成。综合来看，这些发现为世界模型的表征先验如何塑造WAMs的泛化性能提供了一个几何视角。

Authors: Junha Chun, Youngjoon Jeong, Taesup Kim

State-Dependent Objective Coordination for End-to-End Balance and Navigation RLRobot

state-dependent objective coordination end-to-end reinforcement learning two-wheeled inverted-pendulum robot navigation and balance zero-shot deployment

简要说明：本文提出一种基于俯仰角条件的标量化系数，用于端到端强化学习中的状态依赖目标协调，使两轮倒立摆机器人在无需辅助控制器的情况下同时实现导航、避障与平衡，并在仿真和硬件零样本部署中验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a pitch-conditioned scalarization coefficient for state-dependent objective coordination in end-to-end reinforcement learning, enabling a two-wheeled inverted-pendulum robot to achieve navigation and obstacle avoidance while maintaining balance without auxiliary controllers, validated in simulation and zero-shot on hardware.

Abstract: Traditional robotic navigation systems separate mapping, planning, and low-level control through cascaded modules, introducing computational overhead and accumulated latency. End-to-end reinforcement learning offers a compact unified policy that maps onboard observations directly to control actions. However, on inherently unstable platforms such as two-wheeled inverted-pendulum robots, navigation progress and obstacle avoidance can conflict with attitude stabilization in a strongly state-dependent manner. We propose a lightweight state-dependent objective coordination method for integrated navigation and control. A pitch-conditioned scalarization coefficient $β(s)\in[0,1]$ adjusts the relative contributions of balance stabilization and navigation objectives during training, without extra control hierarchies or auxiliary attitude-stabilization controllers, such as proportional-integral-derivative (PID) or linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) controllers. To support zero-shot deployment, simulation training models execution delay, action hold, asynchronous and noisy observations, and dynamics uncertainty. Gradient analysis reveals persistent directional interference and state-dependent variation in the objectives' relative scales. Comparisons with alternative reward-weighting, constraint, training, and control-structure strategies show that PPO+$β(s)$, where PPO denotes proximal policy optimization, achieves 98% and 95% success rates with small attitude excursions on the fixed obstacle map and the randomly generated high-obstacle-density map, respectively. Zero-shot hardware experiments further demonstrate bounded attitude behavior and consistent obstacle avoidance using only onboard observations. Training and evaluation code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）：传统机器人导航系统通过级联模块分离建图、规划与底层控制，从而引入了计算开销和累积延迟。端到端强化学习提供了一种紧凑的统一策略，能够将机载观测直接映射为控制动作。然而，在诸如两轮倒立摆机器人等固有失稳平台上，导航进程和避障目标可能以强状态依赖的方式与姿态稳定产生冲突。我们提出了一种轻量级的、面向状态依赖的目标协调方法，用于导航与控制的集成实现。一个俯仰条件化的标量化系数$β(s)\in[0,1]$在训练过程中动态调节平衡稳定目标与导航目标的相对贡献，无需额外的控制层级或辅助姿态稳定控制器（例如比例-积分-微分（PID）控制器或线性二次型调节器（LQR）控制器）。为支持零样本部署，仿真训练中建模了执行延迟、动作保持、异步含噪观测以及动力学不确定性。梯度分析揭示了目标相对尺度上持续存在的方向性干扰和状态依赖变化。与备选的奖励加权、约束、训练及控制结构策略的对比结果表明，PPO+$β(s)$（其中PPO表示近端策略优化）在固定障碍地图和随机生成的高密度障碍地图上分别实现了98%和95%的成功率，且姿态偏移较小。零样本硬件实验进一步验证了仅利用机载观测即可实现有界的姿态行为和一致的避障性能。训练与评估代码将在论文被接收后公开。

Authors: Xuhao Huang, Xitao Xu, Yuxin Zheng, Yunfan Ren, Zheng Gong

Causal world models under physical parameter shifts WorldModel

causal world models physical parameter shift out-of-distribution prediction robot link-mass extrapolation CausalWorld

简要说明：本文研究了物理参数偏移下的因果世界模型，表明物理参数进入动力学机制的方式决定预测性能，在CausalWorld中手指局部模型改善了超出范围质量的预测。

TLDR: This paper investigates causal world models under physical parameter shifts, showing that how physical parameters enter dynamics mechanisms determines predictive performance, with finger-local models in CausalWorld improving out-of-range mass extrapolation.

Abstract: World models predict how embodied systems evolve under actions, but their accuracy can degrade when physical conditions move outside the training distribution. We study two components of causal modeling: which inputs a predictor may use, and how its mechanism computes their effects. In a synthetic benchmark with shortcut features, a frozen dependency mask derived from paired interventions reduces mean out-of-distribution (OOD) RMSE from 1.769 for a fully connected predictor to 0.697, close to the generator-oracle mask (0.694). For robot link-mass extrapolation in CausalWorld, with disjoint training and test mass ranges, we develop finger-local world models in which link masses enter inertia and dynamics-bias terms through explicit affine coefficients, actions act through either a learned torque network or the known PD controller, and learned residuals capture contact-related effects. Compared with a separately trained control whose mass inputs are fixed at training means, the known-PD model turns out-of-range masses into a consistent predictive gain: median time-averaged joint R2 over 150-step rollouts rises from 0.609 to 0.727, with improvement in all ten task-seed runs (exact two-sided sign test, p = 0.002). In a shared 100-step forecast, the learned-torque model is competitive with the strongest recurrent robotic world model (RWM) configuration (median joint R2 of 0.755 - 0.768 versus 0.752), whereas supplying out-of-range masses sharply degrades the MLP and recurrent predictors. These results indicate that how a physical parameter enters the dynamics mechanism determines whether its out-of-range value helps or harms prediction.

摘要（中文）：世界模型预测实体系统在动作作用下如何演化，但当物理条件偏离训练分布时，其准确性可能下降。本研究考察因果建模的两个组成部分：预测器可以使用哪些输入，以及其机制如何计算这些输入的影响。在包含捷径特征的合成基准测试中，由成对干预得到的冻结依赖掩码将分布外（OOD）均方根误差从全连接预测器的1.769降至0.697，接近生成器-神谕掩码的水平（0.694）。在CausalWorld的机器人连杆质量外推任务中，训练与测试质量范围互不重叠，我们开发了手指局部世界模型，其中连杆质量通过显式仿射系数进入惯性和动力学偏置项，动作通过习得的力矩网络或已知的PD控制器发挥作用，习得残差则捕捉接触相关效应。与质量输入固定为训练均值、单独训练的控制模型相比，已知PD模型将范围外质量转化为一致的预测增益：150步展开中，时间平均关节R2中位数从0.609提升至0.727，且全部十个任务-种子运行均有所改善（精确双侧符号检验，p = 0.002）。在共享的100步预测中，习得力矩模型与最强的循环机器人世界模型（RWM）配置相当（关节R2中位数为0.755～0.768，对比0.752），而将范围外质量输入则显著降低MLP和循环预测器的性能。这些结果表明，物理参数进入动力学机制的方式决定了其范围外取值是有助于还是有害于预测。

Authors: Chu Lin, Yi Sun

RoPT: Robust 6DoF Object Pose Tracking in Video Perception3D

6DoF object pose tracking kinematic factor graph active re-localization multi-hypothesis verification robotic interaction

简要说明：RoPT 提出了一种闭环 6DoF 物体姿态跟踪框架，结合视觉掩码跟踪、运动学因子图正则化和主动重定位，以实现快速运动下的鲁棒跟踪，适用于机器人交互。

TLDR: RoPT proposes a closed-loop 6DoF object pose tracking framework that combines visual mask tracking, kinematic factor-graph regularization, and active re-localization to achieve robust tracking under rapid motion for robotic interactions.

Abstract: Accurate 6-DoF object pose tracking is essential for robotic interaction, yet conventional monocular pipelines frequently suffer from catastrophic divergence under rapid object motion. We present RoPT, a robust tracking framework engineered to overcome this limitation by unifying visual perception, temporal kinematics, and global re-localization into a tightly coupled closed loop. Unlike existing open-loop trackers, RoPT delivers three critical capabilities that fundamentally alter system resilience. First, the visual perception component tracks object masks to robustly handle partial and severe occlusions. Second, a kinematic factor graph regularizes frame-to-frame updates, forecasts forward pose predictions, and drives a parallel multi-hypothesis verification scheme to bypass local minima. Finally, an active re-localization module transforms the pipeline into a closed-loop system, making it failure-aware and capable of deterministic self-recovery. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework across challenging benchmarks alongside real-world robotic demonstrations, achieving significantly higher tracking survivability under rapid motion.

摘要（中文）：精确的六自由度物体姿态追踪对于机器人交互至关重要，然而传统单目追踪流程在物体快速运动时常遭受严重的发散问题。我们提出RoPT，一种鲁棒追踪框架，旨在通过将视觉感知、时间运动学与全局重定位统一于紧密耦合的闭环系统中来克服此局限。与现有开环追踪器不同，RoPT提供三项关键能力，从根本上改变系统韧性。首先，视觉感知组件追踪物体掩膜，以稳健处理部分及严重遮挡。其次，运动学因子图规范化帧间更新，预测前向姿态，并驱动并行多假设验证方案以绕过局部极小值。最后，主动重定位模块将流程转变为闭环系统，使其具备故障感知能力并能够确定性自我恢复。我们通过具有挑战性的基准测试及真实机器人演示验证了框架的有效性，在快速运动下实现了显著更高的追踪存活率。
