Authors: Yongqing Liang, Yuzhong Chen, Sihang Li, Junsuk Kim, Chase Kidder, Hui-ping Wang, Yunzhi Xu, Raihan Haque, Yubiao Zhang, Chen Feng

SLoSa: Small, Low-Power, and Safe Foundation Models for Robotic Task Planning Other

neuro-symbolic task planning safety fine-tuning PDDL

简要说明：SLoSa 提出了一种神经符号压缩与微调框架，用于训练紧凑的4B-14B语言模型进行安全机器人任务规划，通过监督微调和基于验证的强化学习，在边缘硬件和真实机器人上实现了高成功率和低功耗。

TLDR: SLoSa introduces a neuro-symbolic compression and fine-tuning framework that trains compact 4B-14B language models for safe robotic task planning, using supervised fine-tuning and verification-based RL to achieve high success rates with low power consumption on edge hardware and real robots.

Abstract: Safe robotic task planning requires planners that can reliably achieve task goals while satisfying safety constraints. Classical planners search over explicit symbolic task representations and can provide formal guarantees with respect to encoded safety constraints, but require rigid input formats. Their computational cost also increases rapidly with the search space. In contrast, large language models (LLMs) offer flexible task interfaces and strong generalization capabilities, but they are large, power-hungry, and pre-trained with little robot-specific safety data and knowledge. Thus, they can be difficult to deploy locally on robotic systems with limited resources. To address these limitations, we present SLoSa, a neuro-symbolic compression and fine-tuning framework for training foundation-model-based robotic task planners with Small size, Low power demand, and Safety awareness. The framework first constructs a safety-aware dataset using classical planners, an advanced teacher LLM, and formal verifiers, followed by two training stages: supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning guided by a verification-based reward machine to enforce safety alignment. We evaluate SLoSa across four Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) domains, two household simulation environments, local edge platforms, and a desktop robotic arm. Across the PDDL tasks, verifier-guided post-training raises the success rate of compact 4B-14B planners to 70.5-76.0%, while INT4 deployment on a Jetson Orin requires 17.85-26.41 W of average power. Results in household simulators and on the physical robot further demonstrate the applicability of SLoSa across diverse robotic task settings.

摘要（中文）：安全机器人任务规划要求规划器能够在满足安全约束的同时可靠地实现任务目标。经典规划器在显式符号任务表征上进行搜索，能够针对编码的安全约束提供形式化保证，但要求严格的输入格式，且其计算成本随搜索空间增大而迅速上升。相比之下，大语言模型（LLM）提供灵活的任务接口和强大的泛化能力，但模型规模大、功耗高，且预训练过程中缺乏机器人专用的安全数据与知识，因此难以部署在资源受限的本地机器人系统上。为解决上述问题，我们提出SLoSa，一种神经符号压缩与微调框架，用于训练基于基础模型、具备小规模、低功耗和安全感知能力的机器人任务规划器。该框架首先利用经典规划器、高阶教师LLM及形式化验证器构建安全感知数据集，随后进行两个训练阶段：监督微调和基于验证奖励机的强化学习（RL）微调，以强化安全对齐。我们在四个PDDL领域、两个家庭仿真环境、本地边缘平台及一台桌面机械臂上对SLoSa进行了评估。在PDDL任务中，验证器引导的后训练将4B–14B紧凑型规划器的成功率提升至70.5%–76.0%，而在Jetson Orin上的INT4部署平均功耗为17.85–26.41 W。在家庭仿真器及实体机器人上的实验结果进一步验证了SLoSa在多样化机器人任务场景中的适用性。

GGraph: A GPU-Accelerated Library for Graph-Based Robot Deployment and Learning Other

简要说明：GGraph是一个用于机器人部署和学习的GPU加速图库，支持实时图更新和数百个并行机器人的大规模强化学习，将训练时间减少一个数量级。

TLDR: GGraph is a GPU-accelerated graph library for robot deployment and learning, enabling real-time graph updates and scalable reinforcement learning across hundreds of parallel robots, reducing training time by an order of magnitude.

Abstract: Autonomous mobile robots require spatial representations that capture geometry and semantics while staying sparse enough for planning in large, unknown environments. Graphs provide a natural representation for this purpose and underpin both classical planning methods and a growing class of reinforcement-learning (RL) policies. However, RL training needs hundreds to thousands of parallel environments, each constructing and updating its own graph. Existing graph libraries are typically designed for either single-robot deployment or fixed graphs, and CPU-based graph construction limits scalable training to only a few dozen environments. We introduce GGraph, an open-source GPU-accelerated graph library for both robot deployment and large-scale learning. GGraph supports real robots through ROS 2 interfaces and vectorized GPU-based policy training, with built-in support for tasks including 3-D navigation, exploration, and loop-closure integration. For single-robot operation, GGraph updates graphs in milliseconds. At scale, it enables graph-based exploration policies to train across hundreds of parallel robots, reducing wall-clock training time by one order of magnitude. Across simulation and real-world experiments, these results establish GGraph as a unified graph infrastructure for both large-scale robot learning and deployment.

摘要（中文）：自主移动机器人需要能够同时捕捉几何与语义信息、并保持足够稀疏以支持大范围未知环境中规划的空间表示。图结构为此提供了一种自然表示方式，既支撑经典规划方法，也支撑日益增长的强化学习策略。然而，强化学习训练需要成百上千个并行环境，每个环境都需要构建并更新自身的图。现有的图库通常要么面向单机器人部署设计，要么仅支持固定图，而基于CPU的图构建方式将可扩展训练限制在仅几十个环境之内。我们提出GGraph，一个开源的GPU加速图库，既适用于机器人部署，也适用于大规模学习。GGraph通过ROS 2接口支持真实机器人，并提供基于GPU的向量化策略训练，内置支持三维导航、探索及回环闭合集成等任务。在单机器人运行场景下，GGraph可在毫秒级内完成图更新。在大规模场景下，它使基于图的探索策略能够在数百个并行机器人上进行训练，将端到端训练时间缩短一个数量级。通过仿真与真实世界实验，这些结果确立了GGraph作为统一图基础设施在大规模机器人学习与部署中的有效性。

Authors: Yash Rampuria, Rohan Garg, Daniele Gammelli, Marco Pavone

Flexible Language-Guided Representation Editing for Adaptive Robot Behavior Manipulation

feature editing language-guided robot representation navigation manipulation

简要说明：FLEX提出了一种基于语言引导的特征编辑流程，通过添加、泛化或遮蔽任务特征来优化机器人内部表征，并在导航和操作任务中实现自适应行为提升，包括真机验证。

TLDR: FLEX introduces a language-guided feature editing pipeline that adds, generalizes, or masks task features in robot internal representations, improving adaptive behavior across navigation and manipulation tasks with real-robot evaluation.

Abstract: Trajectory demonstrations show robots how to behave but not why, leaving them to guess which features of the task actually matter. Incorrect guesses produce misaligned internal representations and lead to incorrect robot behaviors. Because task features are often semantically defined, we argue that natural language is better suited for specifying features rather than relying on demonstrations. Although existing representation editing methods have proposed using language to specify new features, only allowing additive edits produces feature sets that are often over-specified or too narrowly scoped, especially in sequential editing tasks. We propose the Flexible Feature Editing Pipeline (FLEX), which uses language models to iteratively refine a robot's internal representation of task features from natural language corrections via three complementary operations: Add missing features, Generalize existing specific features, and Mask irrelevant features. We evaluate FLEX on 2D navigation scenarios, 7DoF Franka tabletop manipulation tasks, and a real-world study using naturalistic human language corrections and real-robot demonstrations. Comparisons against single-operation and unscaffolded baselines show that all three operations are necessary in interactive scenarios, and that FLEX achieves consistently higher normalized reward compared to other feature editing approaches while maintaining compact, transferable representations. Project available at https://mit-clear-lab.github.io/FLEX/

摘要（中文）：轨迹示教展示了机器人的行为方式，却未阐明其行为原因，致使机器人不得不自行猜测任务中哪些特征真正重要。错误的猜测会产生错位的内部表征，进而导致机器人行为出错。鉴于任务特征往往具有语义定义，我们认为自然语言比依赖示教更适合用于指定特征。尽管现有的表征编辑方法已提出利用语言来指定新特征，但仅允许加法式编辑所生成的特征集往往过于具体或范围过窄，尤其在序列化编辑任务中更是如此。我们提出了灵活特征编辑流水线（FLEX），该方法利用语言模型，通过三种互补操作——添加缺失特征、泛化现有具体特征、遮蔽无关特征——基于自然语言修正来迭代优化机器人对任务特征的内部表征。我们在二维导航场景、7自由度Franka桌面操作任务以及一项使用自然人类语言修正与真实机器人演示的实物研究中评估了FLEX。与单操作及无脚手架基线的对比表明，在交互场景中三种操作均不可或缺，且与其他特征编辑方法相比，FLEX在保持表征紧凑、可迁移的同时，实现了持续更高的归一化奖励。项目链接：https://mit-clear-lab.github.io/FLEX/

Authors: Audrey Lee, Nathaniel Dennler, Ilia Sucholutsky, Andreea Bobu

Human-Robot Interaction via Meta-Learning Based Mode Recognition and Adaptive Control Manipulation

meta-learning mode recognition adaptive control human-robot interaction force-dependent parameters

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于元学习的人机交互框架，无需预设阈值即可识别人类意图模式，并通过自适应控制器补偿人类扰动，实现了更高的模式识别率和鲁棒控制性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a meta-learning-based framework for human-robot interaction that recognizes human intention modes without predefined thresholds and uses an adaptive controller to compensate for human disturbances, achieving improved mode recognition and robust control.

Abstract: In human-robot interaction (HRI) tasks, humans may interact with the robot in either an active guiding or passive following state, resulting in distinct control objectives for each interaction mode. Most existing approaches rely on predefined switching thresholds to distinguish interaction modes, but their performance can be sensitive to measurement noise. To address this limitation, we propose a novel framework with the following key contributions. First, a neural network (NN) trained via meta-learning is developed to recognize human intention without manually defined thresholds. By successfully incorporating force-dependent parameters from the controller, the recognition rates are improved from 90.1\% to 99.1\% for the passive mode and from 79.8\% to 97.1\% for the active mode. Second, an adaptive meta-learning controller is introduced to compensate for human disturbances and enable online adaptation to varying interaction forces. Third, a multiple-trajectory meta-learning algorithm is designed to jointly learn an environment-basis representation and force-dependent parameters, allowing the controller to deal with unmodeled dynamics efficiently. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves robust and accurate control performance, while providing reliable mode recognition for safe and adaptive physical HRI.

摘要（中文）：在人机交互（HRI）任务中，操作者可能以主动引导或被动跟随的状态与机器人进行交互，从而导致每种交互模式对应不同的控制目标。现有方法大多依赖预设的切换阈值来区分交互模式，但其性能可能受到测量噪声的影响。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，主要贡献如下。首先，开发了一种通过元学习训练得到的神经网络（NN），用于在无需人工设定阈值的情况下识别人类意图。通过成功引入控制器中依赖力的参数，被动模式的识别率从90.1%提升至99.1%，主动模式的识别率从79.8%提升至97.1%。其次，引入了一种自适应元学习控制器，用于补偿人类干扰，并实现对变化交互力的在线自适应。第三，设计了一种多轨迹元学习算法，用于联合学习环境基元表示和依赖力的参数，从而使控制器能够高效处理未建模动态。实验结果表明，所提出的框架在实现鲁棒且精确的控制性能的同时，还能为安全自适应的物理人机交互提供可靠的模式识别。

Authors: Nuo Chen, Ya-Jun Pan

FaultGene: LLM-Assisted Fault-Augmented Test Generation for Hardware-in-the-Loop Validation of Autonomous Driving Systems AutonomousDriving

LLM-assisted test generation hardware-in-the-loop validation fault injection autonomous driving Scenic/CARLA

简要说明：FaultGene是一个基于LLM的框架，用于自动生成自动驾驶系统硬件在环验证的故障增强测试用例，通过语义和执行反馈改进候选测试。

TLDR: FaultGene is an LLM-assisted framework that automatically generates fault-augmented test cases for hardware-in-the-loop validation of autonomous driving systems, using semantic and execution feedback to refine candidate tests.

Abstract: Reliable validation of autonomous driving cyber-physical systems requires testing not only nominal driving behavior but also failures arising from faults in sensing and embedded computation. Physical road testing provides realistic system behavior but is costly and difficult to reproduce, while simulation enables scalable evaluation but cannot fully capture hardware-dependent behavior and fault propagation. Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) validation bridges this gap by executing the driving stack on real embedded hardware within a simulated environment. However, preparing fault-augmented scenarios for HIL testing remains largely a manual process, limiting test coverage, scalability, and efficiency. We present FaultGene, an LLM-assisted framework for automated generation of executable fault-augmented tests for HIL fault-resilience validation. Given a baseline Scenic/CARLA scenario and a structured fault specification, FaultGene generates a fault-augmented test case that captures the effects of HIL-level fault injection. During offline refinement, semantic-consistency checks and execution-level feedback are used to correct candidates that fail to preserve the intended scenario context or produce the desired fault-induced degradation, and to construct high-quality supervision for fine-tuning. The resulting generator then produces fault-augmented tests directly at deployment time without requiring manually engineered reference executions or repeated refinement loops.

摘要（中文）：可靠地验证自动驾驶信息物理系统，不仅需要测试标称驾驶行为，还需测试由感知与嵌入式计算中的故障所引发的失效情形。物理道路测试能提供真实的系统行为，但成本高昂且难以复现；而仿真虽支持可扩展评估，却无法完全捕捉依赖硬件的行为与故障传播过程。硬件在环（HIL）验证通过在模拟环境中运行真实嵌入式硬件上的驾驶软件栈，弥合了这一差距。然而，为HIL测试准备故障增广场景在很大程度上仍依赖人工流程，限制了测试覆盖率、可扩展性与效率。 我们提出FaultGene——一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化框架，用于为HIL故障韧性验证生成可执行的故障增广测试。给定基线Scenic/CARLA场景及结构化故障规范，FaultGene生成一个故障增广测试用例，以捕捉HIL级故障注入的效果。在离线精化阶段，利用语义一致性检查与执行级反馈来修正未能保留预期场景上下文或未能产生所需故障诱发性能下降的候选用例，并为微调构建高质量监督信号。由此得到的生成器在部署时可直接生成故障增广测试，无需人工设计的参考执行或重复的精化循环。

Authors: Chaoran Yuan, Fadi Kurdahi

FogTTA: Online Test-Time Adaptation for Robust Transformer-based Object Detection in Foggy Weather AutonomousDriving

test-time adaptation object detection foggy weather teacher-student RF-DETR

简要说明：FogTTA提出了一种用于Transformer目标检测器的在线测试时自适应框架，以在雾天自动驾驶条件下保持性能，采用教师-学生架构、伪标签细化和指数移动平均更新，提升实时检测精度。

TLDR: FogTTA presents an online test-time adaptation framework for Transformer-based object detectors to maintain performance in foggy autonomous driving conditions, using a teacher-student architecture with pseudo-label refinement and exponential moving average updates, and improves detection accuracy in real-time.

Abstract: Object detection models for autonomous driving commonly experience substantial performance drops when deployed under adverse weather due to the domain shift between training data and real-world operating conditions. This degradation is especially evident when models trained on clear-weather images encounter foggy environments with reduced visibility and contrast. To address this challenge, we introduce FogTTA, an online test-time adaptation framework designed to improve the robustness of Transformer-based object detectors in fog. Using RF-DETR as the underlying object detector, FogTTA enables real-time adaptation to the streaming target domain without requiring source data or retraining. The framework follows a teacher-student design, where the deployed model serves as the teacher and generates pseudo labels from weakly augmented target inputs. These predictions are subsequently refined through non-maximum suppression and confidence filtering. The student model then learns from strongly augmented target sample using the Varifocal loss to mitigate pseudo-label noise. The teacher is updated via exponential moving averaging to ensure stable and continuous adaptation. Experiments show that FogTTA outperforms prior baselines, delivering improved detection accuracy and stability while maintaining real-time performance.

摘要（中文）：用于自动驾驶的目标检测模型在不利天气条件下部署时，通常会因训练数据与实际运行环境之间的领域差异而出现显著的性能下降。当在晴朗天气图像上训练的模型遭遇能见度降低、对比度下降的雾天环境时，这种性能退化尤为明显。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了FogTTA，一种在线测试时自适应框架，旨在提升基于Transformer的目标检测器在雾天环境中的鲁棒性。FogTTA以RF-DETR作为底层目标检测器，能够在不依赖源数据或重新训练的情况下，实现对流式目标域的实时自适应。该框架采用师生设计，其中已部署的模型作为教师，从弱增强的目标输入中生成伪标签，这些预测结果随后通过非极大值抑制和置信度过滤进行精炼。学生模型则利用强增强的目标样本，通过Varifocal损失进行学习，以减轻伪标签噪声的影响。教师模型通过指数移动平均进行更新，确保稳定且持续的自适应过程。实验表明，FogTTA在保持实时性能的同时，优于先前基线方法，实现了更高的检测精度和稳定性。

Authors: Ali Abedi, Q. M. Jonathan Wu, Ning Zhang, Shiqi Tian

Events, Not Pixels: Where World Models Get the Return Wrong WorldModel

world models planning return error event transitions diagnostic

简要说明：该论文提出了一种世界模型的转换级诊断方法，表明事件转换（获得奖励或回合结束的地方）是回报误差的主要来源，修复这些事件可以改善规划，尽管它们在视觉上与其他步骤一样忠实。

TLDR: This paper introduces a transition-level diagnostic for world models, showing that event transitions (where rewards are earned or episodes end) drive most return error and that repairing these events improves planning, despite being as visually faithful as other steps.

Abstract: World models are increasingly used for planning, where a planner ranks candidate actions by returns imagined by the model. However, these models are judged mainly by how well they render frames, even though a visually faithful rollout can still assign the wrong return. To identify where this mismatch arises, we introduce a transition-level diagnostic that replaces imagined transitions with real ones and measures the reduction in return error against a budget-matched random control. Our analysis yields two findings. (1) Event transitions, the few steps where a reward is earned or an episode ends, are rendered as well as other steps (median pixel-error ratio 0.85), yet restoring them removes a median of 70% of the return error. In contrast, restoring transitions with the largest MSE, SSIM or LPIPS error removes less than a random choice. Across the 44 Atari-100k model--collection pairs that pass our reliability checks, including three released families, event patches outperform random patches in 39 (sign test p=1.4 x 10^{-7}), with a median gain of +44 percentage points. (2) The remaining error is structured: a complementary patch separates errors at true events from those elsewhere, while an eight-step timing tolerance recovers few events missed by our deterministic models. This structure also guides repair: a rule recorded before four repair outcomes were known predicts when a diffusion model repairs these failures. Event patches improve plan ranking, and the same concentration appears on control tasks with rare reward events.

摘要（中文）：世界模型越来越多地被用于规划任务，其中规划器根据模型想象出的回报对候选动作进行排序。然而，这些模型主要依据其渲染帧的质量来评判，尽管视觉上逼真的推演仍可能赋予错误的回报。为了定位这一偏差产生的根源，我们引入了一种转换级诊断方法，用真实转换替换想象中的转换，并对照预算匹配的随机控制组测量回报误差的减少量。我们的分析得出两个发现。（1）事件转换，即获得奖励或回合结束的少数几个步骤，其渲染质量与其他步骤相当（中位像素误差比为0.85），但恢复这些转换可消除中位数70%的回报误差。相比之下，恢复MSE、SSIM或LPIPS误差最大的转换所消除的误差少于随机选择。在通过我们可靠性检查的44个Atari-100k模型-集合配对中，包括三个已发布的模型系列，事件修补在39个配对中优于随机修补（符号检验p=1.4 x 10^{-7}），中位数增益为+44个百分点。（2）剩余误差具有结构性：一种互补修补方法将真实事件处的误差与其他位置的误差区分开来，而八步的时间容差仅能恢复少量被我们确定性模型遗漏的事件。这种结构也为修复提供了指导：在四个修复结果已知之前记录的一条规则，能够预测扩散模型何时能修复这些失败。事件修补改善了计划排序，并且同样的集中性也出现在具有稀疏奖励事件的控制任务中。

Authors: Haoyue Liu, Xiaoying Tang

Second Thoughts: Exploring and Planning through Comparative Imagination in World Models WorldModel

world models exploration planning sibling disagreement reinforcement learning

简要说明：本文提出了SDI方法，通过在世界模型中利用想象的分歧来统一探索与规划，提高了连续控制基准任务的表现。

TLDR: This paper introduces SDI, a method that uses sibling disagreement in imagination within world models to unify exploration and planning, improving task performance in continuous control benchmarks.

Abstract: World models let agents compare imagined outcomes before acting, but an agent must still decide which alternatives to explore and when a proposed plan should replace its learned policy. We introduce SDI (Sibling Disagreement in Imagination), which connects these decisions through a shared actor-based reference. SDI compares action sequences imagined from the same model state, using repeated rollouts of the actor's own sequence to measure variation under fixed behavior. This reference scales both the spread across candidate returns, which provides an exploration signal, and a proposed plan's predicted advantage, which governs action acceptance. The agent executes a planned action when its advantage exceeds the reference variability by a fixed factor; otherwise, it follows the actor. SDI reuses the base agent's world model, actor, and critic without requiring an additional disagreement ensemble. Exploration and planning guide training data collection, while evaluation uses the learned actor alone. Across Meta-World, Adroit, and DM-Control, SDI achieves a higher observed task-average score than every compared baseline in each suite and matches or exceeds the strongest baseline's performance on 15 of 18 tasks. Component ablations and robustness analyses further examine the roles of exploration, planning exposure, and action acceptance. Paired evaluations from identical simulator states show that the gate improves both recovery from actor failures and preservation of successful behavior relative to ungated planning, while substantially reducing return degradation. Together, these results support comparing imagined alternatives against a shared actor reference as a unified approach to exploring and planning with world models.

摘要（中文）：世界模型使智能体能够在行动之前比较想象的结果，但智能体仍需决定探索哪些备选方案，以及提议的计划何时应取代其已学习的策略。我们提出SDI（想象中的孪生分歧），通过一个共享的、基于行动的参考框架将这两个决策联系起来。SDI比较从同一模型状态想象出的行动序列，利用行动者自身序列的重复推演来衡量固定行为下的变异性。该参考同时放大了候选回报之间的离散程度（提供探索信号）以及提议计划的预测优势（决定行动接受与否）。当计划的优势超过参考变异性的一定倍数时，智能体执行计划中的行动；否则，遵循行动者的策略。SDI复用基础智能体的世界模型、行动者和评论家，无需额外的分歧集成。探索与规划引导训练数据的收集，而评估仅使用学习到的行动者。在Meta-World、Adroit和DM-Control基准上，SDI在每一套件中均取得了比所有对比基线更高的观测任务平均得分，并在18项任务中的15项上达到或超过最强基线的表现。组件消融和稳健性分析进一步考察了探索、规划暴露和行动接受的作用。来自相同模拟器状态的配对评估显示，相对于无门控规划，该门控在改善行动者失败的恢复和保持成功行为方面均有所提升，同时显著减少回报退化。综合来看，这些结果支持将想象备选方案与共享行动参考进行比较，作为世界模型中探索与规划的统一方法。

Authors: Hieu Tran, Hong Yu

CausalAlign: Causal Alignment of Video Generation Models for Consistent Ego-Motion WorldModel

ego-motion consistency causal alignment diffusion-based video generation world action models mobile manipulation

简要说明：CausalAlign 是一个因果对齐框架，通过将扩散视频生成模型中识别层的表示与3D基础模型对齐，改善了自我运动一致性，从而在移动操作任务中提升了世界动作模型的成功率。

TLDR: CausalAlign is a causal alignment framework that improves ego-motion consistency in diffusion-based video generation models by aligning representations at identified layers with a 3D foundation model, leading to better geometric consistency and enhanced success rates for world action models in mobile manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Diffusion-based video generation models (VGMs) can produce visually plausible videos, yet their camera ego-motion often drifts over long horizons. Camera ego-motion determines how the viewpoint changes between frames and is essential for maintaining consistent geometry and trajectories. To address this problem, we propose CausalAlign, a causal alignment framework with two components. First, we diagnose how precise ego motion is represented, used, and retained within VGMs using linear probes and causal interventions, revealing a rise-and-fall pattern during denoising. Second, we strengthen ego-motion state in VGM by aligning the representations at the identified layers to a 3D foundation model through delta-token space. This space encodes the changes between consecutive frames, allowing the alignment to focus on ego-motion dynamics rather than static scene content. With Wan2.2 fine-tuned on DL3DV and RealEstate10K, CausalAlign can largely improve motion accuracy, geometric consistency, and temporal smoothness, while preserving visual quality. For example, it improves geometric consistency by more than 20% relative to the base model. Moreover, with the fine-tuned VGM, CausalAlign improves the success rate of world action models (WAMs) by 10 points on mobile manipulation tasks of RoboCasa365 benchmark. Overall, CausalAlign improves ego-motion consistency in diffusion-based VGMs and yields noticeable gains in embodied models.

摘要（中文）：基于扩散的视频生成模型（VGMs）能够生成视觉上合理的视频，但其相机自我运动在长时间跨度内往往会出现漂移。相机自我运动决定了帧间视角的变化方式，对于保持几何一致性和轨迹稳定性至关重要。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为CausalAlign的因果对齐框架，该框架包含两个组成部分。首先，我们利用线性探针和因果干预手段，诊断自我运动在VGMs中的精确表示、使用与保留方式，揭示出在去噪过程中呈现出的先升后降模式。其次，我们通过增量标记空间将识别层上的表示与三维基础模型进行对齐，从而增强VGM中的自我运动状态。该空间编码了连续帧之间的变化，使对齐过程能够专注于自我运动动态而非静态场景内容。通过在DL3DV和RealEstate10K数据集上微调的Wan2.2模型，CausalAlign能够大幅提升运动精度、几何一致性和时间平滑度，同时保持视觉质量。例如，与基础模型相比，其几何一致性提升了超过20%。此外，在微调后的VGM基础上，CausalAlign在RoboCasa365基准的移动操作任务中将世界行动模型（WAMs）的成功率提高了10个百分点。总体而言，CausalAlign改善了基于扩散的VGM中的自我运动一致性，并在具身模型中带来了显著增益。

Authors: Kai Zhu, Yintianrun Zhang, Shuwei Jiang, Ruolin Zuo, Yixin Chen, Duomin Wang, Miao Liu, Yin Li, Daquan Zhou, Yiwu Zhong

LiveAct: Towards Real-Time Multi-Agent World Models with Heterogeneous Action Interfaces WorldModel

multi-agent world model heterogeneous action interface video generation agent-aware spatial modulation causal generator

简要说明：提出了LiveAct，一种具有异构动作接口的多智能体视频世界模型，支持独立控制多个视觉实体并适应多样化的控制语义，实现游戏和多机器人操作中的实时流式生成。

TLDR: Introduces LiveAct, a multi-agent video world model with a heterogeneous action interface that supports independent control of multiple visual entities and adaptation to diverse control semantics, enabling real-time streaming generation for games and multi-robot manipulation.

Abstract: Interactive video world models predict how an environment evolves under user actions, but most existing systems assume one controlled agent and one task-specific action interface. We study multi-agent video world modeling, where one model generates a joint visual future for multiple controlled agents while interpreting heterogeneous controls ranging from binary game buttons to continuous robot commands. This task presents two complementary challenges. First, every agent-indexed action stream must control its intended visual entity independently. Second, the model must adapt the meaning of each control variable across different tasks, where the same tensor dimension may denote an attack, steering command, or robot command. We introduce LiveAct, centered on a Heterogeneous Action Interface (HAI) whose two components mirror this decomposition. To support independent control, Agent-Aware Spatial Modulation uses language-driven spatial gates and agent-specific attention to bind each action stream to its intended visual agent. To accommodate heterogeneous controls, Schema-Guided Action Adaptation describes each control variable in language and modulates its semantic token with the synchronized numerical value. We further transfer the complete interface to a blockwise causal generator through teacher forcing and rollout-aware distribution matching, enabling efficient streaming generation while retaining agent-specific control and action semantics. We instantiate the formulation on six multi-agent sources spanning games and multi-robot manipulation, and evaluate visual quality, action following, agent attribution, and latency. Across games and robot manipulation, LiveAct reaches 0.898 and 0.942 agent-attribution accuracy without agent locations or identity crops, and the causal generator attains 17.70 FPS at $512\times 448$.

摘要（中文）：交互式视频世界模型预测环境在用户操作下如何演变，但现有大多数系统假设只有一个受控智能体和一个任务特定的动作接口。我们研究多智能体视频世界建模，其中单个模型在解释从二进制游戏按钮到连续机器人命令的异构控制时，为多个受控智能体生成联合视觉未来。这一任务带来了两个互补的挑战。首先，每个按智能体索引的动作流必须独立控制其预期的视觉实体。其次，模型必须适应不同任务中每个控制变量的含义，其中相同的张量维度可能表示攻击、转向命令或机器人命令。我们引入了LiveAct，其核心是异构动作接口（HAI），该接口的两个组成部分镜像了这一分解。为支持独立控制，智能体感知的空间调制利用语言驱动的空间门控和智能体特定的注意力，将每个动作流绑定到其预期的视觉智能体。为适应异构控制，模式引导的动作适配用语言描述每个控制变量，并通过同步的数值调制其语义令牌。我们进一步通过教师强制和基于展开的分布匹配将完整接口迁移到分块因果生成器，在保留智能体特定控制和动作语义的同时，实现高效的流式生成。我们在涵盖游戏和多机器人操作六个多智能体数据源上实例化该框架，并评估视觉质量、动作跟随、智能体归因和延迟。在游戏和机器人操作中，LiveAct在无智能体位置或身份裁剪的情况下分别达到0.898和0.942的智能体归因准确率，因果生成器在512×448分辨率下达到17.70帧每秒。

Authors: Xinyu Wang, Huafeng Shi, Yue Ma, Zijie Meng, Teng Xi, Yuzhuo Chen, Yucheng Wang, Ruicheng Zhang, Guoxin Zhang, Pengfei Wan, Xiu Li, Fangneng Zhan

FM-Occ: Feature-Diverse Upsampling and Memory-Aware Decoding for 3D Occupancy Prediction AutonomousDriving

3D occupancy prediction sparse subvoxel shuffle layer-wise memory entropy regularization SemanticKITTI

简要说明：本文提出FM-Occ，通过特征多样上采样（3S）和熵调节层间记忆（ER-LM）改进3D占用预测，在SemanticKITTI上提升语义占用精度，适用于自动驾驶。

TLDR: This paper introduces FM-Occ, a 3D occupancy prediction method with Feature-Diverse Upsampling (3S) and Entropy-Regulated Layer-wise Memory (ER-LM), improving semantic occupancy accuracy on SemanticKITTI for autonomous driving.

Abstract: 3D semantic occupancy prediction estimates voxel-wise occupancy and semantic labels throughout a scene. Our experiments reveal that conventional sparse transposed-convolution upsampling yields poorly differentiated voxel responses and that successive decoder layers discard previously correct semantic predictions. To address these issues, we present Feature-Diverse Upsampling and Memory-Aware Decoding for 3D Occupancy Prediction (FM-Occ), comprising two components. First, 3D Sparse Subvoxel Shuffle (3S) mitigates feature homogenization by constructing candidate child features in the channel dimension, jointly transforming and normalizing them, and then rearranging them onto a finer sparse grid with explicit feature-coordinate correspondence. Second, Entropy-Regulated Layer-wise Memory (ER-LM) retains semantic information across decoder layers by maintaining a layer-wise memory for each query through gated recurrent updates and using prediction entropy to regulate the historical information propagated to the next layer. During training, a class-weighted entropy loss Lcwe provides label-guided regularization for matched semantic queries. On SemanticKITTI, 3S increases the spatial coefficient of variation of normalized voxel-wise root-mean-square (RMS) responses from 0.41% to 4.03%, while ER-LM reduces semantic degradation and improves error correction across decoder layers. The combined FM-Occ improves mIoU from 12.16% to 12.73% with negligible memory overhead. ER-LM further improves mIoU in the BEV-based DISC framework from 16.78% to 17.17%, supporting its applicability across 3D voxel-based and BEV-based architectures.

摘要（中文）：三维语义占用预测旨在估计整个场景中逐体素的占用情况与语义标签。我们的实验揭示，传统的稀疏转置卷积上采样会导致体素响应区分度不足，且逐层解码器会丢弃先前正确的语义预测。为解决这些问题，我们提出了面向三维占用预测的特征多样上采样与记忆感知解码方法（FM-Occ），包含两个组成部分。首先，三维稀疏子体素重排（3S）通过在通道维度构建候选子体素特征，对其联合变换与归一化，并将其重新排列到具有显式特征-坐标对应关系的更精细稀疏网格上，从而缓解特征同质化问题。其次，熵调控的逐层记忆机制（ER-LM）通过门控循环更新为每个查询维护逐层记忆，并利用预测熵调控传递至下一层的历史信息，从而在各解码器层间保留语义信息。在训练阶段，类别加权熵损失 \( L_{cwe} \) 为匹配的语义查询提供标签引导的正则化。在SemanticKITTI数据集上，3S将归一化逐体素均方根（RMS）响应的空间变异系数从0.41%提升至4.03%，而ER-LM则减少了语义退化，并提升了跨解码器层的错误修正能力。二者结合的FM-Occ将mIoU从12.16%提升至12.73%，且内存开销可忽略不计。ER-LM进一步将基于BEV的DISC框架中的mIoU从16.78%提升至17.17%，表明其适用于三维体素与BEV两种架构。

Authors: Yujia Zhai, Guoming Huang, Zhuanghuai Wang, Bangquan Xie

Robot Generalization Beyond Volume: The Diversity Path via Zero-Shot Capabilities Manipulation

zero-shot generalization data diversity shared latent space generative augmentation community data collection

简要说明：本文提出机器人零样本泛化主要依赖数据多样性而非数据量，并设计了共享动作潜在空间，结合多模态对齐、生成式增强和噪声标签学习，以及名为Origami的社区数据收集平台。

TLDR: This paper proposes that zero-shot generalization in robotics scales with data diversity rather than volume, and introduces a shared latent action space with multi-modal alignment, generative augmentation, and noisy-label learning, plus a community-based data collection platform called Origami.

Abstract: General-purpose robots must handle tasks, objects and environments they were never trained on, yet zero-shot generalization remains one of the least solved problems in physical AI. In digital AI, zero-shot capability grew with the volume and, above all, the diversity of training data, much of it sourced from the crowd. Robotics instead relies on paid collection by a few well-funded teams, which yields volume without diversity. We formulate zero-shot generalization in physical AI as coverage of the deployment distribution, and show that more samples from the same collectors shrink the unseen region only slowly, while each new contributor can extend it. Building on this and on zero-shot learning, we propose a shared latent space for robot actions that combines multi-modal alignment, generative augmentation, and noisy-label learning. As a scalable source of diverse data, we propose a community of developers building applications on one standard, approachable robot, Origami. We close with a testable hypothesis and an evaluation protocol relating real-robot zero-shot success to the diversity of contributed data.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人必须应对它们从未训练过的任务、物体和环境，然而零样本泛化仍然是物理人工智能中解决最少的问题之一。在数字人工智能领域，零样本能力随着训练数据的规模，尤其是多样性的增长而提升，其中大量数据来源于众包。而机器人技术则依赖少数资金充足的团队进行有偿采集，这虽然带来了数据量，却缺乏多样性。我们将物理人工智能中的零样本泛化定义为对部署分布的覆盖，并表明来自同一采集者的更多样本只会缓慢缩小未见区域，而每一位新增贡献者则可能扩展该覆盖范围。基于此及零样本学习，我们提出了一种用于机器人动作的共享潜在空间，该空间结合了多模态对齐、生成式增强和噪声标签学习。作为多样化数据的可扩展来源，我们建议构建一个开发者社区，在一个标准化且易于操作的机器人“Origami”上开发应用。最后，我们提出了一个可检验的假设以及一套评估协议，将真实机器人的零样本成功率与贡献数据的多样性联系起来。

Authors: Rafael Felix, Flavia Yanase

Sufficient and Necessary Causal Explanations for the Analysis of Autonomous Systems AutonomousDriving

causal explanations failure analysis autonomous systems counterfactual generation causal responsibility

简要说明：本文提出了用于自主系统故障规避的必要因果解释，补充了用于故障复现的充分解释，并基于因果责任提出了高效近似算法，在反事实生成中优于现有方法。

TLDR: This paper introduces necessary causal explanations for failure avoidance in autonomous systems, complementing sufficient explanations for reproduction, and proposes an efficient approximation algorithm based on causal responsibility, demonstrating improved counterfactual generation.

Abstract: Understanding failures of autonomous systems is challenging, particularly when their behavior depends on black-box components such as neural networks. In this work, we make a distinction between two objectives of failure analysis: reproduction, which seeks to identify conditions sufficient to reproduce an observed failure, and avoidance, which seeks to identify the changes required to prevent it. Previous work on causal explanations of system failures is based on the concept of sufficient explanations and naturally supports reproduction. Nevertheless, we observe that it does not address the problem of avoiding the failure. In this paper, we introduce and formalize the concept of necessary explanations for system analysis as the correct formalism for failure avoidance. We place necessary explanations in the framework of actual causality and show that, together with sufficient explanations, they provide a unified causal framework for addressing both objectives of failure analysis. We present an efficient approximation algorithm for generating necessary explanations based on the notion of causal responsibility. We evaluate the efficiency of our approach across multiple environments. We demonstrate the practical utility of necessary explanations for failure avoidance through counterfactual generation and show that it outperforms existing methods.

摘要（中文）：理解自治系统的故障具有挑战性，尤其是当它们的行为依赖于神经网络等黑箱组件时。在本研究中，我们区分了故障分析的两个目标：复现，旨在识别足以复现所观察故障的条件；以及避免，旨在识别防止该故障所需的变化。先前关于系统故障因果解释的工作基于充分解释的概念，自然地支持复现。然而，我们观察到它并未解决避免故障的问题。在本文中，我们引入并形式化了系统分析中必要解释的概念，将其作为故障避免的正确形式化方法。我们将必要解释置于实际因果关系的框架中，并表明，与充分解释一起，它们为处理故障分析的两个目标提供了统一的因果框架。我们提出了一种基于因果责任概念的高效近似算法，用于生成必要解释。我们在多种环境中评估了我们方法的效率。我们通过反事实生成展示了必要解释在故障避免中的实际效用，并表明其优于现有方法。

AirPlayground: Benchmarking Aerial Navigation across Diverse Reconstructed Environments Other

aerial navigation 3D Gaussian Splatting benchmark closed-loop evaluation policy learning

简要说明：AirPlayground是一个用于空中导航的统一基准，提供94个逼真的3DGS环境、94K条专家飞行演示和标准化API，用于训练和评估各种策略范式，并分析扩展行为和闭环性能。

TLDR: AirPlayground is a unified benchmark for aerial navigation, providing 94 photorealistic 3DGS environments, 94K expert flight demonstrations, and a standardized API for training and evaluating various policy paradigms, with analyses of scaling behavior and closed-loop performance.

Abstract: Large-scale aerial resources provide a foundation for learning navigation across diverse environments. However, existing resources remain limited in providing (1) densely sampled flight demonstrations for learning different policy formulations and (2) broad environment coverage for standardized closed-loop evaluation. To address these limitations, we introduce AirPlayground, a unified benchmark for training and evaluating aerial navigation policies across diverse environments. We first construct 94 photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) environments spanning indoor, urban outdoor, and vegetation settings, with aligned collision geometry. Building on these environments, we develop a scene-adaptive pipeline for automated expert flight collection, yielding 94K demonstrations and 46.5M synchronized observation-state-action samples at 50 Hz. We further provide an extensible API that supports training different policy formulations on this shared corpus and evaluating them under unified protocols in the corresponding environments. We benchmark seven baselines spanning four policy paradigms across three navigation settings in seen and unseen environments, and further examine scaling behavior with ACT. Scaling ACT's training corpus from 5 to 70 scenes raises median success rates on seen and unseen environments from 30.6% and 16.8% to 41.2% and 29.4%, respectively. Through this shared training and evaluation framework, AirPlayground supports analysis of how offline prediction errors relate to closed-loop outcomes. Our analyses highlight the roles of prediction errors, execution protocols, and scene interactions in closed-loop performance.

摘要（中文）：大规模空中资源为跨多样环境的导航学习提供了基础。然而，现有资源在以下两方面仍存在局限：(1) 为不同策略形式的学习提供密集采样的飞行演示；(2) 为标准化闭环评估提供广泛的环境覆盖。为解决这些局限，我们引入AirPlayground，一个用于跨多样环境训练和评估空中导航策略的统一基准。我们首先构建了94个涵盖室内、城市场外及植被环境的高保真3D高斯溅射(3DGS)环境，并配有对齐的碰撞几何体。在这些环境基础上，我们开发了一种场景自适应的自动化专家飞行采集流程，生成了94K条演示及在50 Hz频率下的46.5M个同步观测-状态-动作样本。我们进一步提供了可扩展API，支持在该共享语料库上训练不同策略形式，并在相应环境中按统一协议进行评估。我们在可见与不可见环境中的三种导航设置下，对涵盖四种策略范式的七种基线进行了基准测试，并进一步考察了ACT的扩展行为。将ACT的训练语料从5个场景扩展到70个场景，可见与不可见环境下的中位成功率分别从30.6%和16.8%提升至41.2%和29.4%。通过这一共享训练与评估框架，AirPlayground支持分析离线预测误差与闭环结果之间的关系。我们的分析突显了预测误差、执行协议及场景交互在闭环性能中的作用。

Authors: Rangya Zhang, Yujing Shang, Zhuoyuan Yu, Mingsheng Li, Qingsong Yan, Chao Yan, Yuhang Zhang, Mir Feroskhan

Reading the Room: Scale-ambiguous Semantic Registration of Sparse VSLAM Maps to Floor Plans in Partially Built Environments Perception3D

VSLAM semantic registration floor plan construction energy function

简要说明：该论文提出一种全局-局部方法，利用鲁棒的类平衡语义几何能量函数和全局初始化方案，将稀疏语义VSLAM地图配准到部分建造的楼层平面图，用于机器人施工进度跟踪。

TLDR: This paper introduces a global-local approach to register sparse semantic VSLAM maps to partially built floor plans for robotic construction progress tracking, using a robust class-balanced semantic-geometric energy function and global initialization schemes.

Abstract: Many robotic construction applications, such as progress tracking, require registering a sensor trajectory to a prior 2D floor plan. Visual capture is attractive for its low cost and availability, but aligning a visual simultaneous localization and mapping (VSLAM) map to a floor plan is difficult; VSLAM recovers geometry only up to an unknown similarity transform, the sparse point cloud is cross-modal to the symbolic floor plan, sites are only partially built during capture, and construction sites are visually repetitive, degrading map quality while removing distinctive features. Existing methods address at most two of these challenges. We thus introduce Reading the Room(RR), a global-local approach to register scale-ambiguous, sparse, semantic VSLAM maps to partially built floor plans. Our key idea is to define a single robust, differentiable, class-balanced semantic-geometric energy function that governs all stages of the pipeline. We develop two global initialization schemes, leveraging a single inaccurate user-provided correspondence if provided, or estimating the initialization globally using a cross-modal matching network. Both schemes are designed to find initial candidates with respect to the energy function, which is then directly optimized for local refinement. We evaluate RR on 33 sequences across three active construction sites against classical and learning-based baselines, achieving a 4.5x improvement in mean absolute trajectory error over the strongest baseline in the general unconstrained setting, which increases to 7.6x when an anchor is provided.

摘要（中文）：许多机器人施工应用（如进度跟踪）需要将传感器轨迹配准到先验的二维平面图上。视觉采集因其低成本和易获取性而具有吸引力，但将视觉同步定位与建图（VSLAM）地图与平面图对齐十分困难；VSLAM仅能在未知相似变换下恢复几何结构，稀疏点云与符号化平面图之间存在跨模态差异，施工场地在采集时仅部分建成，且施工现场视觉上具有重复性，这降低了地图质量并去除了显著特征。现有方法最多只能应对其中两项挑战。为此，我们提出了“读屋”（Reading the Room，RR）方法，这是一种全局-局部结合的策略，用于将尺度模糊、稀疏的语义VSLAM地图配准到部分建成的平面图上。我们的核心思想是定义一个单一稳健、可微、类别平衡的语义-几何能量函数，该函数统辖流程的所有阶段。我们开发了两种全局初始化方案，一种利用用户提供的单个不准确对应点（若可用），另一种则通过跨模态匹配网络全局估计初始化姿态。两种方案均旨在以该能量函数为目标寻找初始候选解，随后直接对该函数进行优化以实现局部精化。我们在三个在建施工现场的33个序列上，将RR与经典方法及基于学习的方法进行对比，在一般无约束场景下，平均绝对轨迹误差相较最强基线提升了4.5倍；当提供锚点时，该提升进一步增至7.6倍。

Authors: Bjorn Stragier, Emilia Szymańska, J. Micah Prendergast, Lukas Rosenberger Schmid

Extending Affordance Segmentation for Wearable Robots to Multi-Object Images Manipulation

affordance segmentation wearable robots grasp selection laser pointer disambiguation mixed reality training

简要说明：本文通过引入激光指针进行物体消歧，并利用混合现实生成的多物体图像重新训练CNN，提升了上肢假肢视觉抓取部位识别的目标选择准确率（最高提升9%），且不增加计算成本。

TLDR: This paper enhances vision-based graspable part recognition for upper-limb prostheses by adding a laser pointer for object disambiguation and retraining CNNs with mixed-reality-generated multi-object images, improving target selection accuracy by up to 9% without extra computational cost.

Abstract: This paper proposes a refinement to existing vision-based portable pipelines for the recognition of graspable object parts. Such pipelines can effectively support automatic grasp selection and preshaping in upper-limb prosthetic devices. However, realistic scenarios in which multiple objects are present still represent a challenge. The proposed method exploits a minor modification to the conventional hardware setup and a custom training approach to extend the applicability of vision-based pipelines. A laser pointer is introduced in the setup as an effective mechanism for object disambiguation. Accordingly, a suitable retraining of the deep convolutional neural networks supporting recognition of graspable parts is implemented. A mixed reality strategy allows the reuse of available high-quality segmentation masks to generate realistic images procedurally, extending the range of scenarios supported by the final device. Experimental results confirm that the proposed pipeline improves target disambiguation accuracy by up to 9% compared with existing solutions, while preserving the computational cost.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种对现有基于视觉的可抓取物体部件识别便携式流程的改进方法。此类流程能够有效支持上肢假肢装置中的自动抓取选择与预成形操作。然而，在多个物体同时存在的现实场景中，仍面临挑战。所提方法通过对常规硬件设置进行小幅修改，并结合自定义训练方式，扩展了基于视觉流程的适用范围。在设置中引入激光指示器，作为有效的物体消歧机制。据此，对支持可抓取部件识别的深度卷积神经网络进行了相应的重新训练。一种混合现实策略允许复用现有高质量分割掩码，以程序化方式生成逼真图像，从而扩展最终设备所支持的场景范围。实验结果表明，与现有方案相比，所提流程在保持计算成本不变的前提下，将目标消歧准确率提升最多达9%。

Authors: Simone Lugani, Matteo Montani, Paolo Gastaldo, Rodolfo Zunino, Edoardo Ragusa

AOV-GS: Active Open-Vocabulary Semantic Mapping with 3D Gaussian Splatting Other

active mapping open-vocabulary 3D Gaussian Splatting CLIP SAM

简要说明：AOV-GS 提出了一种主动式 3D 高斯建图系统，利用冻结的基础模型（CLIP 和 SAM）将探索偏向语义信息丰富的区域，并离线拟合轻量级语言场以支持开放词汇查询分割，在 Replica 和 Matterport3D 数据集上相较于仅几何规划的基线提升了语言场 mIoU。

TLDR: AOV-GS presents an active 3D Gaussian mapping system that uses frozen foundation models (CLIP and SAM) to bias exploration toward semantically informative regions and fits a lightweight language field offline for open-vocabulary query segmentation, improving language-field mIoU over geometry-only baselines on Replica and Matterport3D.

Abstract: Robots deployed in human-centered environments need maps that support both geometric navigation and open-vocabulary semantic queries beyond a fixed label set. A key challenge is enriching such maps with semantic information without relying on manually annotated segmentation masks or closed-set semantic categories. Existing geometry-driven active mapping maximizes coverage but treats semantics as a passive by-product of the collected trajectory, whereas active semantic mapping typically depends on supervised semantic segmentation. We present AOV-GS, an active 3D Gaussian mapping system that guides exploration using frozen foundation models. During coarse exploration, AOV-GS re-ranks geometrically promising candidate views according to CLIP mask-embedding novelty computed from SAM instance segmentation, biasing exploration toward semantically informative regions. Frozen SAM and CLIP provide instance masks and language-aligned embeddings throughout mapping, while a lightweight scene-specific language field is fitted offline directly to the collected CLIP embeddings rather than manually annotated masks, enabling open-vocabulary text-query segmentation on novel views. In a controlled comparison using the same SAM-CLIP perception stack, AOV-GS improves average language-field mIoU over geometry-only active planning by 1.3 percentage points on Replica (34.6% on eight scenes) and by 1.8 points on Matterport3D (23.1% on five scenes). With CorrCLIP, AOV-GS reaches 35.6% on Replica, 2.0 points above the matched Geometry-based + CorrCLIP baseline. Novel-view PSNR remains comparable to the geometry-only baseline on both datasets while depth L1 improves on Replica. Code is available at https://github.com/OptimusFaber/AOV-GS.

摘要（中文）：部署在以人为中心的环境中的机器人需要的地图，既要支持几何导航，也要支持超越固定标签集合的开放词汇语义查询。一个关键挑战是，在无需依赖人工标注的分割掩码或封闭集语义类别的情况下，为这类地图补充语义信息。现有的几何驱动主动建图方法能够最大化覆盖范围，但将语义视为采集轨迹的被动副产品；而主动语义建图通常依赖监督式语义分割。我们提出了AOV-GS，一个使用冻结基础模型引导探索的主动三维高斯建图系统。在粗略探索阶段，AOV-GS根据由SAM实例分割计算得到的CLIP掩码嵌入新颖性，对几何上有前景的候选视角重新排序，将探索偏向于语义信息丰富的区域。在整个建图过程中，冻结的SAM和CLIP提供实例掩码和语言对齐嵌入，而一个轻量级的场景专属语言场则离线直接拟合到采集到的CLIP嵌入上，而非人工标注掩码，从而支持在新视角上进行开放词汇文本查询分割。在使用相同SAM-CLIP感知栈的受控对比实验中，AOV-GS相比仅采用几何主动规划的方法，在Replica数据集上将平均语言场mIoU提升了1.3个百分点（八个场景达到34.6%），在Matterport3D数据集上提升了1.8个百分点（五个场景达到23.1%）。结合CorrCLIP后，AOV-GS在Replica上达到35.6%，比匹配的基于几何+CorrCLIP基线高出2.0个百分点。在两个数据集上，新视角PSNR与仅几何基线相当，而在Replica上深度L1有所改善。代码可在 https://github.com/OptimusFaber/AOV-GS 获取。

Authors: Rodion Shkokov, Tatiana Zemskova, Dmitry Yudin

Payload generalization on feedforward control actions for trajectory tracking in robots with rigid and elastic joints Manipulation

feedforward control payload generalization trajectory tracking elastic joints learning-based control

简要说明：本文提出一种方法，用于在不同负载下泛化学习的前馈控制动作，实现机器人轨迹跟踪，无需动力学模型且能处理弹性关节，并在Franka Emika Panda机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method to generalize learned feedforward control actions across different payloads for robot trajectory tracking, requiring no dynamic model and handling elastic joints, validated on a Franka Emika Panda robot.

Abstract: Industries employ robots for repetitive tasks due to their high precision and performance, typically achieved through feedforward control actions based on an accurate robot description. However, an exact dynamic model can be difficult to obtain, especially for robots with elastic elements or when the payload changes. Learning-based feedforward approaches are promising for trajectory tracking under model uncertainties, but typically face generalization issues when task parameters vary. This paper proposes a novel method to generalize the feedforward control action with respect to payload parameters, independently of the underlying controller. Firstly, the minimal number of example objects needed for payload generalization is derived. Then, an algorithm is proposed to execute the same trajectory with a new payload, given only its parameters, without knowledge of the robot's dynamic model and even in the presence of elastic joints. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is validated in simulations and experiments on tracking tasks with different robots and controllers. Two sets of experiments are performed: on a standard Franka Emika Panda robot, and on a Franka Emika Panda robot equipped with an elastic wrist.

摘要（中文）：工业领域采用机器人执行重复性任务，这得益于其高精度和高性能，而这些通常依赖于基于精确机器人模型的反馈前馈控制动作。然而，获取精确的动力学模型可能十分困难，尤其是对于含有弹性元件的机器人或当负载发生变化时。基于学习的反馈前馈方法在模型不确定性下的轨迹跟踪中展现出潜力，但当任务参数变化时，通常面临泛化问题。本文提出了一种新方法，用于独立于底层控制器，对负载参数实现反馈前馈控制动作的泛化。首先，推导了负载泛化所需的最少示例对象数量。然后，提出了一种算法，仅凭新负载的参数，即可在无需知晓机器人动力学模型甚至存在弹性关节的情况下，执行相同的轨迹。该算法的有效性通过在多种机器人和控制器上的跟踪任务仿真与实验中得到验证。实验设置了两组：一组使用标准Franka Emika Panda机器人，另一组使用配备弹性腕部的Franka Emika Panda机器人。

Authors: Giorgia Pazzi, Giorgio Simonini, Michele Pierallini, Paolo Salaris, Giorgio Grioli, Manolo Garabini, Franco Angelini

One Policy, Many Styles: Where to Aggregate Preferences for Steerable Humanoid Control? Locomotion

preference-conditioned RL steerable control humanoid control preference aggregation reward responsiveness

简要说明：本文评估了偏好条件强化学习中不同偏好聚合级别（奖励、优势、损失、PCGrad）对可操控人形机器人控制的影响，并使用新指标来衡量响应性、泄漏和任务性能。

TLDR: This paper evaluates different preference aggregation levels (reward, advantage, loss, PCGrad) for steerable humanoid control in preference-conditioned RL, using new metrics to assess responsiveness, leakage, and task performance across frameworks.

Abstract: Modern robotic agents are increasingly expected to support steerable control, where a single policy can adjust its behavioral style at runtime under changing user preferences. Preference-conditioned reinforcement learning provides this interface, but conditioning alone does not ensure that a requested behavior change is strong, does not leak into unrelated behaviors, and does not compromise task performance. Our evaluation combines Preference Reward Responsiveness (PRR) with coverage and utility metrics. We use these measures to compare reward-level, advantage-level, loss-level, and PCGrad-based aggregation across two humanoid-control frameworks. No aggregation level performs best across all environments and criteria. Experiments show that aggregating objectives early produces a wider range of behavioral responses but greater unintended changes in other objectives, while aggregating them later improves control precision at some cost to responsiveness.

摘要（中文）：现代机器人智能体日益需要支持可操控控制，即在用户偏好动态变化时，单个策略能够在运行时调整其行为风格。基于偏好的强化学习提供了这一接口，但仅靠条件设定并不能确保所请求的行为变化足够显著、不会波及无关行为，也不会损害任务性能。我们的评估结合了偏好奖励响应性（PRR）与覆盖率和实用性指标。利用这些度量，我们在两个类人控制框架中比较了基于奖励级、优势级、损失级及PCGrad的聚合方法。没有任何一种聚合级别在所有环境和标准下均表现最佳。实验表明，早期聚合目标能够产生更广泛的行为响应，但会导致其他目标的更大非预期变化；而晚期聚合目标则能提升控制精度，但会以部分响应性为代价。

Authors: Ziqian Huang, Yuzhuo Chen, Shimin Zhang, Junyang He, Xinyue Annie Yang, Animesh Garg

Learning-Enhanced Observer for Sensorless Task-Null-Space Compliant Control Manipulation

wrench observer physical human-robot interaction task-null-space decomposition hybrid pose/force control neural network compensation

简要说明：本文提出一种无传感器柔顺控制框架，用于物理人机交互，通过神经网络增强的力观测器、任务-零空间分解和混合位姿/力控制器，在无需力/力矩传感器的情况下实现鲁棒估计和跟踪。

TLDR: This paper introduces a sensorless compliant control framework for physical human-robot interaction, integrating a neural-network-enhanced wrench observer with task-null-space decomposition and a hybrid pose/force controller to achieve robust estimation and tracking without force/torque sensors.

Abstract: This paper presents a novel framework integrating a robust wrench observer with a hybrid pose and force controller for physical Human-Robot Interaction (pHRI). In pHRI tasks, robots are expected to perform task-space motions robustly while remaining compliance with human disturbance, which proposes distinct control objectives. Most existing approaches focus mainly on either robustness or compliance and rely on force sensors for real-time tracking. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework with the following key contributions. Firstly, a neural network (NN) is trained to improve the observer performance by compensating for system friction and unmodeled dynamics. Secondly, a task-null-space decomposition is applied to separate the joint velocity and reduce the effect of the human disturbance on the observer. Finally, a hybrid pose and force controller is introduced to achieve the end-effector pose and force tracking. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework provides robust and accurate wrench estimation while maintaining reliable pose and force tracking performance. The proposed approach offers an effective solution and framework for pHRI without the need of force/torque sensor measurements which can be applied to many robotic manipulator platforms which do not have force/torque sensors.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种新颖框架，将鲁棒力/力矩观测器与混合位姿与力控制器相结合，用于物理人机交互（pHRI）。在pHRI任务中，期望机器人在执行任务空间运动时兼具鲁棒性，同时保持对人类干扰的柔顺性，这提出了不同的控制目标。现有方法大多侧重于鲁棒性或柔顺性中的某一方面，并依赖力传感器实现实时跟踪。为解决上述局限，本文提出了一种具有以下关键贡献的新颖框架。首先，训练神经网络（NN）以补偿系统摩擦及未建模动力学，从而提升观测器性能。其次，采用任务-零空间分解以分离关节速度，降低人类干扰对观测器的影响。最后，引入混合位姿与力控制器，实现末端执行器的位姿与力跟踪。实验结果表明，所提框架在保持可靠位姿与力跟踪性能的同时，能够提供鲁棒且精确的力/力矩估计。该方法为无需力/力矩传感器测量的pHRI提供了一种有效解决方案与框架，可广泛应用于未配备力/力矩传感器的多种机器人操作平台。

Authors: Nuo Chen, Ya-Jun Pan, Onur Toker

Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation WorldModel

autoregressive video generation future chunk prediction world models teacher forcing physical plausibility

简要说明：FCP 通过预测没有视觉上下文的未来块来改进自回归视频生成，在较低计算预算下增强物理合理性和结构化表示空间，这表明对世界模型有价值。

TLDR: FCP improves autoregressive video generation by predicting future chunks without visual context, enhancing physical plausibility and structured representation spaces at lower compute budgets, suggesting value for world models.

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution. We introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective jointly optimized with teacher-forced denoising that predicts temporally separated chunks without access to the intervening visual context. Drawing supervision directly from training videos, FCP requires no additional pretrained visual encoder and leaves autoregressive inference unchanged. Our method achieves superior physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training with a lower overall training compute budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision for modeling visual evolution. Intriguingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP fosters a more structured representation space, which may be valuable for building autoregressive world models.

摘要（中文）：自回归视频扩散模型逐块生成视频，然而生成合理的延续并不能保证模型捕捉到了场景的演变过程。在教师强制（teacher forcing）机制下，强时间冗余可能使局部视觉连续性成为当前块去噪的捷径，从而降低了对视觉演变建模的压力。我们引入了未来块预测（Future Chunk Prediction, FCP）作为辅助目标，与教师强制去噪联合优化，该目标在缺乏中间视觉上下文的情况下预测时间上分离的块。由于直接以训练视频为监督信号，FCP无需额外的预训练视觉编码器，且不改变自回归推理过程。相较于标准教师强制自回归训练，我们的方法在更低的总训练计算预算下实现了更优的物理合理性，凸显了未来块监督在视觉演变建模中的有效性与高效性。有趣的是，可视化结果表明FCP促进了更具结构化的表征空间，这可能对构建自回归世界模型具有重要价值。

Authors: Ruopeng Gao, Yukun Huang, Jiarui Hu, Shuai Wang, Wenbo Hu, Ying Shan, Limin Wang

DewHand: Direct Metric World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos Other

hand motion reconstruction egocentric video flow matching world-space camera motion

简要说明：DewHand 是一个统一模型，直接从第一人称视频中单阶段重建度量世界坐标系下的手部和相机运动，采用流匹配生成式流程，相较于多阶段基线提高了精度和时间一致性，并支持向具身智能体的迁移。

TLDR: DewHand is a unified model that directly reconstructs metric world-space hand and camera motion from egocentric video using a single-stage, flow-matching generative pipeline, improving accuracy and temporal consistency over multi-stage baselines and enabling transfer to embodied agents.

Abstract: Recovering metric world-space hand motion from egocentric video supports understanding human interactions and transferring them to embodied agents. Three challenges complicate this task: multi-stage pipelines propagate errors from independently estimated hand and camera motion; monocular observations leave physical scale ambiguous; and occlusion and out-of-view hands admit multiple plausible motion trajectories. We present DewHand, a unified model for direct joint reconstruction of world-space hand and camera motion. To avoid compounding errors from multi-stage estimation, DewHand jointly predicts hand and camera motion in a shared world coordinate system within a single-stage pipeline. To resolve metric-scale ambiguity, it combines scene-level geometric features from VGGT-$Ω$ with metric-space supervision, while hand-specific features preserve fine-grained articulation. To handle occlusion and out-of-view hands, we formulate reconstruction as conditional motion generation with flow matching. Under the same architecture, this generative formulation outperforms direct regression in both accuracy and temporal smoothness with only two sampling steps. Experiments on HOT3D and ARCTIC demonstrate improved world-space accuracy and temporal consistency over state-of-the-art methods. DewHand reduces rigid-aligned world-space error relative to StableHand from 32.9 to 28.4 mm on HOT3D and from 76.2 to 36.2 mm on ARCTIC. It also recovers camera scale within 10% on two thirds of HOT3D clips, versus about a quarter for SLAM. Moreover, in zero-shot evaluations on HoloAssist, H2O, and TACO, captured with different devices, DewHand achieves the lowest rigid-aligned world-space error (WA-MPJPE) on each dataset.

摘要（中文）：从第一视角视频中恢复度量世界坐标系下的手部运动，有助于理解人机交互并将其迁移至具身智能体。这一任务面临三大挑战：多阶段流程会因独立估计手部和相机运动而产生误差累积；单目观测使物理尺度存在模糊性；遮挡及手部移出视野则导致存在多种合理的运动轨迹。我们提出DewHand，一个统一模型，用于直接联合重建世界坐标系下的手部与相机运动。为避免多阶段估计带来的误差累积，DewHand在单阶段流程中于共享世界坐标系内联合预测手部与相机运动。为消除度量尺度模糊性，模型将来自VGGT-Ω的场景级几何特征与度量空间监督结合，同时利用手部特定特征保持细粒度关节细节。为处理遮挡和手部移出视野的情况，我们将重建问题建模为基于流匹配的条件运动生成。在同一架构下，该生成式方案仅需两步采样，便在精度和时间平滑性上均优于直接回归方法。在HOT3D和ARCTIC上的实验表明，相较于现有最优方法，DewHand在的世界坐标精度和时间一致性方面均有提升。在HOT3D上，DewHand将相对于StableHand的刚性对齐世界空间误差从32.9毫米降至28.4毫米；在ARCTIC上则从76.2毫米降至36.2毫米。此外，在HOT3D三分之二的片段中，DewHand恢复的相机尺度误差在10%以内，而SLAM仅覆盖约四分之一。在HoloAssist、H2O和TACO等使用不同设备采集的数据集上的零样本评估中，DewHand在每个数据集上都取得了最低的刚性对齐世界空间误差（WA-MPJPE）。

Authors: Naru Suzuki, Satoshi Ikehata, Takehiko Ohkawa, Yoichi Sato, Shuhei Kurita

WorldStream: Streaming Interactive 3D Worlds with Hierarchical Planning and Persistent State WorldModel

open-ended world model hierarchical planning persistent state language interaction procedural generation

简要说明：WorldStream 是一个开放式的 3D 世界模型，通过分层计划和持久状态实现地形扩展、语言交互以及已编辑区域的恢复，面向交互式应用。

TLDR: WorldStream is an open-ended 3D world model that uses hierarchical planning and persistent state to enable terrain extension, language-driven interaction, and restoration of edited regions, targeting interactive applications.

Abstract: We present WorldStream, an open-ended 3D world model with three simultaneous capabilities: it extends playable terrain beyond any pre-specified map, acts on open-ended language in the running world, and restores visited places with their edits. A hierarchical planner over a typed decision model emits structured decision state: Macro fixes settlement, ecology, transport, and hydrological structure across a group of tiles; Micro specializes that contract into tile semantics under measured terrain and accepted neighbor commitments. Deterministic local code compiles accepted plans into terrain, roads, settlements, vegetation, and entities. Streaming separates their reach: plans run ahead along the predicted corridor, compilation only where movement will soon need it, geometry behind the user released. One world record retains plans, seeds, object identities and mutable state, boundary commitments, and edits by attribute, revised as the user advances and edits; returning tiles recompile from it. The same record grounds interaction: the model acts on existing entities, including stateful NPCs that update as they act, edits the present region, or attaches intent to unplanned regions. Together they yield a world expanding under bounded budgets, connected across independently planned tiles, and interactive.

摘要（中文）：我们提出WorldStream，一个具备三种同步能力的开放式3D世界模型：它能将可游玩地形扩展至任何预设地图之外，能在运行中的世界里响应开放式语言指令，并能恢复曾访问地点及其编辑状态。一个基于类型化决策模型的分层规划器输出结构化的决策状态：宏观层在瓦片组范围内确定定居点、生态、交通和水文结构；微观层在实测地形和已接受的邻域承诺约束下，将该契约细化为瓦片语义。确定性的局部代码将已接受的计划编译为地形、道路、定居点、植被和实体。流式处理将它们的可达范围分开：计划沿预测走廊提前运行，编译仅在移动即将需要之处进行，用户身后的几何体被释放。单一世界记录按属性保留计划、种子、对象身份和可变状态、边界承诺及编辑内容，随用户推进和编辑而更新；返回的瓦片据此重新编译。同一记录支撑交互：模型作用于现有实体，包括随行动更新状态的有状态NPC，编辑当前区域，或将意图附加到未规划区域。这些机制共同构建了一个在有限预算下持续扩展、跨独立规划瓦片保持连通且可交互的世界。
